items.description: What is Contentstack ? Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system. While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time. Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program. Learn more at www.contentstack.com . Who Are We? At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go! What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack. In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making. If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing: Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews. Build governed data models and semantic layers: Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows. Establish analytics engineering best practices: Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability. Enable secure, reliable data access: Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization. Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions. Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices. Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt. What Really Gets Us Excited About You 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform. Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization. Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns. Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs. Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations. Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments. Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders. Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India. Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification. Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads. Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data. Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data. Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security. You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture! What Do We Offer? Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected. Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more! One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining… To review our Privacy Policy, please click here .

items.description: Tiger Analytics is a fast-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for top-notch talent as we continue to build the best analytics global consulting team in the world. The Power BI Architect will lead the design, strategy, and governance of the enterprise BI platform using Microsoft Power BI and the Azure ecosystem. This role involves assessing infrastructure requirements, defining best practices, guiding BI Engineers, enabling security, handling large data, and ensuring scalable, high-performing BI solutions that align with business needs. Key Requirements: Design scalable BI solutions with a focus on infrastructure, capacity, and licensing needs. Conduct capability assessments to align Power BI adoption with enterprise goals. Define and enforce Power BI governance frameworks, including security, data access, and workspace strategy. Provide effort estimations and delivery planning for BI initiatives. Design and optimize semantic/OLAP models (star schema, composite models, aggregations, dataflows) for enterprise-scale reporting. Establish and manage a central metric store for standardized KPIs and calculations. Architect and oversee dashboard/report design, ensuring scalability, usability, and consistency across business units. Partner with Azure Databricks, Synapse, and Data Lake teams to enable efficient BI consumption of large data. Collaborate with Microsoft partner teams to evaluate new capabilities and align with best practices. Define and enforce CI/CD strategies using Git, Azure DevOps, and deployment pipelines. Oversee data refresh automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale. Guide and mentor BI Engineers on best practices in DAX, modeling, performance optimization, and visualization standards. Stay current on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium, and emerging BI trends to future-proof the BI strategy. Qualifications & Skills: 10+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics, with 5+ years in Power BI architecture. Proven experience in designing scalable BI/analytics infrastructure solutions. Expertise in Power BI Premium/Fabric, DAX, Power Query (M), Tabular Models, and large semantic/OLAP models. Strong knowledge of Azure Databricks, Synapse, Data Lake, SQL Server. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines (Git, Azure DevOps, deployment pipelines). Skilled in refresh automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting large models. Strong understanding of data governance, compliance, and enterprise security frameworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Experience working with Microsoft partner teams on solution alignment and best practices. Benefits Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging, and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility. Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

items.description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the transformation of our current data engineering and analytics function into a modern, scalable, product-oriented Data Platform organization. You will define the vision, architecture, operating model, and execution roadmap required to evolve from project-based data delivery to a platform that enables self-service, reliable, governed, and analytics-ready data across the company. This is a deeply hands-on leadership role for a technical expert who actively designs systems, prototypes solutions, reviews code, and guides teams through complex challenges. You will modernize our data stack, establish platform standards, introduce best practices for reliability and governance, and enable teams across the business to build data products efficiently and safely. In addition to platform transformation, you will ensure the data ecosystem delivers high-quality analytics and actionable insights. You will define architecture across ingestion, processing, modeling, semantic layers, analytics, and AI/ML enablement, ensuring data is trustworthy, accessible, secure, and performant. You will work closely with engineering leadership, product teams, analytics, and executive stakeholders to align technology strategy with business outcomes, mentor engineers, and build a data-driven culture. Success in this role means not only delivering a modern platform but also elevating the team’s capabilities, processes, and ways of working to operate as a true Data Platform organization. What you’ll do Architecture & Technical Leadership Define and own the end-to-end data and analytics architecture strategy Design scalable batch, streaming, and real-time data systems Establish standards for data modeling, semantic layers, and reporting Lead architecture reviews and technical decision-making Drive adoption of modern architectures (lakehouse, data mesh, real-time analytics) Hands-On Engineering Design and prototype critical data platform components Write production-quality code for complex or high-impact areas Review schemas, transformations, dashboards, and analytics models Troubleshoot performance and reliability issues across pipelines and queries Optimize workloads for latency, concurrency, and cost Data Platform & Pipeline Ownership Design and architect a scalable data platform supporting ingestion, transformation, and delivery of both structured and unstructured data across batch and real-time pipelines. Design a "Data for Agents" strategy, ensuring our data warehouse is structured with the semantic layers and metadata necessary for LLMs to navigate it accurately. Build AI-ready data infrastructure, including vector stores, embedding pipelines, and retrieval systems that power LLM and agentic workflows. Develop a RAG-ready data architecture that enables trusted enterprise data retrieval with strong lineage, governance, security, and observability. Create curated data products and reusable APIs that make high-quality datasets easily consumable by applications, analytics platforms, and AI agents. Enable self-service data access for engineering, analytics, and business teams through standardized models, semantic layers, and platform capabilities. Partner with AI, product, and engineering teams to support training datasets, feature stores, and production AI inference pipelines. Build agentic ETL/ELT pipelines that use AI agents to autonomously discover sources and generate transformations. Ensure reliability, scalability, and resilience of the platform, including high availability, monitoring, and disaster recovery readiness. Analytics & Business Intelligence Partner with product, finance, business operations, and leadership teams to define analytics needs Design scalable data models for reporting and advanced analytics Ensure analytics solutions are performant, trustworthy, and easy to use Drive adoption of data-driven culture through reliable insights Governance, Quality & Security Define data governance, lineage, cataloging, and metadata standards Establish data quality frameworks and validation processes Ensure privacy, compliance, and secure access to sensitive data Implement role-based access controls and auditability Leadership & Collaboration Mentor senior engineers, analytics engineers, and data scientists Partner with product, ML, platform, and business teams Translate business questions into scalable data solutions Influence roadmaps using data platform and analytics considerations Act as the executive technical authority for data and analytics Operational Excellence Define SLAs/SLOs for data availability, freshness, and accuracy Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes Optimize cloud costs and query performance Support capacity planning for data growth Culture & Enablement Be an evangelist for pragmatic AI adoption. Help establish a culture of outcome-driven innovation. Qualifications Required Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field 15+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles Proven experience architecting large-scale data and analytics systems Strong hands-on experience with modern data stacks in cloud environments Deep expertise in data modeling for analytics (dimensional, star/snowflake, Data Vault, etc.) Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java Advanced expertise in dimensional data modeling and semantic layers (e.g., dbt, Cube) to provide "agent-readable" context. Expertise in real-time streaming frameworks such as Spark, Flink, or Beam. Experience building reporting and BI solutions at scale Strong understanding of both batch and real-time architectures Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP data services Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, etc.) Strong understanding of data governance and security best practices Ability to operate at both executive and deeply technical levels Nice to Have Experience supporting AI/ML pipelines and feature engineering Familiarity with real-time analytics and event-driven architectures Experience implementing semantic layers or metrics stores Background in high-growth SaaS or data-intensive organizations Experience with experimentation platforms or product analytics Compensation Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $235,000 - $285,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Benefits include: Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family Life insurance Mental wellness coverage Fertility and growing family support Flex Time Off in addition to company paid holidays Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies Retirement saving plans Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home Annual professional development stipend Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits. #LI-TG1

items.title: Product Analyst
items.summary: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. Our team is focused on building scalable products and sustainable business models that shape the future of education. We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Platform Development Team. Working hand-in-hand with the Product Manager, you will build product analytics for our core platform from the ground up - and become the person who understands user behavior on the platform better than anyone else. What You'll Do: Build product analytics for the core platform together with the Product Manager: define key metrics, events, funnels, and approaches to evaluating user experience. Design and maintain the event tracking framework - ensuring data is complete, consistent, and trusted across product and technical teams. Identify insights across user journeys, segments, and platform usage scenarios - and automate their regular discovery. Create and evolve dashboards, alerts, and analytics infrastructure used by product and engineering teams for day-to-day decisions. Support product hypotheses with data: validate ideas, evaluate feature impact, and help prioritize the roadmap with evidence. Translate user behavior into clear, actionable recommendations and help teams across the company make data-driven decisions. We're Looking For: 6-8 years of experience as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst in a product IT company (B2C platforms, SaaS, or marketplaces are a plus). Strong SQL skills and confident work with large datasets. Hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar). Solid understanding of product metrics: activation, retention, conversion, funnels, cohorts, and unit-level user behavior. Experience designing event taxonomies and setting up tracking from scratch or significantly evolving an existing setup. Experience with A/B testing and a working knowledge of statistics for experiment evaluation. Ability to turn ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations. Nice to Have: Python or R for analysis and automation of recurring insights. Experience working with platform/infrastructure products or technical stakeholders (engineers, architects). Experience building analytics processes in a team where analytics did not exist before. Strong communication skills: ability to articulate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive, problem-solving mindset - comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Why You'll Love Working With Us: Innovative Environment: We're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech. We are global remote. Health: company-provided medical expense compensation. AI solutions: AI subscription and other tools. Balance: Flexible paid time off - 21 days of annual leave + 10 bank holidays. Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are. --- Hiring Process: 1. Recruiter screen 2. Technical Interview 3. Hiring Manager Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: BI Analyst
items.summary: At Nimble Gravity, we help organizations turn data, technology, and AI into measurable business results.
items.description: At Nimble Gravity , we help organizations turn data, technology, and AI into measurable business results. We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our growing team and help transform data into clear, actionable insights that support business decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, understanding business needs, and building dashboards and reports that make complex information easy to understand and use. What You’ll Do Analyze business data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities. Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support business teams and stakeholders. Work with stakeholders to understand business questions and translate them into reporting and analytics solutions. Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources. Define and track key business metrics and KPIs. Validate data and help ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reports and dashboards. Communicate findings and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate with data, engineering, product, and business teams on analytics initiatives. What You Bring Experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to translate business requirements into meaningful metrics, dashboards, and reports. Good understanding of data modeling and reporting concepts. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Nice to Have Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar . Familiarity with Python or other data analysis tools. Experience working in consulting or client-facing environments. Familiarity with modern data warehousing and analytics practices. Why Join Nimble Gravity ? You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk. Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role OverviewWe are seeking a curious and analytical Data Scientist Intern to support data-driven decision-making across business and technology teams.
items.description: Role Overview We are seeking a curious and analytical Data Scientist Intern to support data-driven decision-making across business and technology teams. This internship offers hands-on experience working with real-world datasets, building analytical models, and translating data insights into actionable outcomes. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates looking to build a strong foundation in data science, analytics, and applied machine learning. Internship Details Duration: 3 months, with potential extension based on performance Work Mode: Remote Stipend: Unpaid initially; performance-based evaluation in the first quarter may lead to a paid internship extension or full-time opportunity Working Hours: 8 hours per day Key Responsibilities Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and patterns Assist in building and validating statistical and machine learning models Create data visualizations and dashboards to communicate insights Support data-driven decision-making through reports and presentations Collaborate with engineering, product, and business teams Document methodologies, findings, and outcomes Required Skills & Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in: Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field Strong understanding of statistics and data analysis fundamentals Proficiency in Python Experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn Basic knowledge of SQL Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Preferred / Technical Skills Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and workflows Exposure to Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) Knowledge of version control systems (Git) Understanding of data pipelines and ETL concepts What You Will Gain Hands-on experience with real-world datasets and business problems Practical exposure to data science and analytics workflows Mentorship from experienced data scientists and engineers Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams Certificate of Internship Completion upon successful completion Opportunity for paid or full-time conversion based on performance Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-business-intelligence-analyst

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Poland At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization. As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure. What you'll do Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows) Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue. What we look for 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Total rewards We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future. In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits. Base Pay Grade - K 226 000 zł - 346 000 zł Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills. In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially. Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars) Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example Equity grade: 2 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000 Annual Refresh: $5,000 Reward equity: $0-$75,000 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month. In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include: Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge. Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package. A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being. Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly. Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members. Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion. Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy. Location - Remote Poland The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland. **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.** #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analytics-engineer-ii-full-stack-revenue-analytics

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/ Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $164,200 — $229,990 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer

Additionally, this role partners closely with application development, data engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, well-governed analytics solutions aligned with regulatory and client requirements in the financial services industry. TECHNOLOGY STACK Snowflake Data Cloud. Microsoft SQL Server and advanced SQL. Power BI (report development, data modeling, and deployment). ETL/ELT frameworks and data pipelines. Microsoft Azure. Data governance, security, and access control tooling. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Designs, develops, and maintains Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic data models that support operational and executive decision-making. Builds and maintains statistical models, trend analyses, and forecasting tools to support fund administration workflows and client reporting. Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs by partnering with governance and quality initiatives. Documents analytical methodologies, data definitions, report logic, and model assumptions to support transparency and auditability. Stays current with emerging trends and capabilities in data science, analytics engineering, and business intelligence tooling. Financial services experience, ideally supporting fund administration or asset management platforms. KNOWLEDGE ETL/ELT tools and modern data engineering frameworks. Regulatory and compliance considerations related to financial data. Statistical analysis, data wrangling, and exploratory data analysis techniques. Machine learning or predictive modeling techniques applied to business use cases. Microsoft Office Suite. Adobe Acrobat. SKILLS AND ABILITIES Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to data accuracy, with experience implementing data validation and quality checks. contributing to or defining enterprise analytics standards and data strategy. Identifies needs, arranges for, and obtains resources to accomplish individual and department goals. Establishes and develops effective working relationships with associates and clientele during both favorable and unfavorable situations. Modifies team and individual priorities and deadlines in response to added information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles and ensures completion. Equivalent education, experience, and KSA’s will be considered. items.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure. Responsibilities Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV) Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams Requirements Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field) Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals) Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior Competency in one or more of the following: SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries) Programming (Python/R for data manipulation) A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI) Preferred Requirements Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA) Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools Interest in crypto/fintech industry Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment) Why Binance Shape the future of finance Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning Competitive salary and company benefits Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice . These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. items.title: Product Manager - Data & Insights
items.summary: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate.
items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Manager, Data & Insights, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics, responsible for delivering intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for both external users and internal stakeholders. You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities—from customer research and data modeling through to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. You will partner closely with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, supports compliance requirements, and delivers meaningful insights for executive decision-making. You will also champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products, ensuring that data is managed responsibly, securely, and in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. Help us shape the future of communication by: Defining and executing the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Be an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design. Collecting business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Developing detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Partnering closely with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and how it impacts performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around extract-transform-load (ETL/ELT) processes and dimensional modeling. Owning and enforcing data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Defining processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Be an advocate for data accuracy and a watchdog for misleading or incomplete insights. Owning the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Defining self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams. Create feedback loops to continually improve dashboard usability and relevance for both internal and external users. Acting as the bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Facilitate decision-making on trade-offs related to data availability, accuracy, and reporting timelines. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in product management, data, analytics, or reporting platforms, with a strong focus on data-driven products. Proven experience delivering customer-facing reporting products, dashboards, and internal analytics solutions. Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance frameworks, including GDPR and PDPL. Experience working cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, product teams, UX, and business stakeholders. Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Vertica, or Snowflake, and BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Sigma. Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas. Familiarity with ELT pipelines, dbt, and data orchestration tools is a plus. Understanding of data quality, data integrity, scalability, and performance considerations when building reporting solutions. Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements. Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives. Ability to balance performance, usability, scalability, and cost when designing data and reporting solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business requirements and insights. Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align stakeholders around data strategy, and communicate reporting goals and insights effectively. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field AI Proficiency: Minimum Level:L4 (Proficient). Applies AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. Expected : Uses AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping, and personally owns the accuracy of every output. Hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable. Writes structured prompts (role, context, constraints, format) and refines the prompt rather than patching outputs by hand. Synthesizes interviews, tickets, and reviews into themes and testable insights, and validates every insight against source data before sharing. Drafts PRDs, user stories, and executive updates with AI as a first-draft partner, then verifies every claim and number before it reaches leadership. Builds clickable prototypes in Lovable to validate ideas with stakeholders, and is clear that a prototype is not production-ready. Understands how AI agents are built (prompts, tools, memory, guardrails) and proactively identifies workflows worth automating. Flags AI risks (hallucination, bias, data privacy, over-reliance) and knows what should and shouldn't be AI-assisted. Craft and Toolkit: Strong SQL and data analysis skills. Experience with data warehouses such as Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Vertica. Knowledge of data modeling, dimensional modeling, data marts, and data pipelines. Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Metabase. Understanding of ETL/ELT, dbt, and data orchestration. Knowledge of data governance, quality, lineage, and compliance. Understanding of GDPR, PDPL, and data privacy principles. Ability to define KPIs, data requirements, data contracts, and reporting specifications. Understanding of scalable, performant, and cost-effective reporting architectures. Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion. Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams. Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals. Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know. Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement. items.description: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners . Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events. The Role The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement. Top Responsibilities: Client Measurement & Data Strategy • Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting. • Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools. • Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value. • Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies. • Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation. Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving • Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews. • Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments. • Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations. • Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams. Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap. • Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights. • Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools. • Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities. Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership • Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks. • Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients. • Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums. • Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms. What Success Looks Like: By 6 Months The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams. By 1 Year The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate: • Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity • Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences • Commercially minded • Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels • Naturally curious and innovative • Confident representing AP as an external thought leader Minimum Qualifications & Skills: • 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy • Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams • Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing • Experience leading teams and developing talent • Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing • Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar) • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics • SQL and data querying experience preferred WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching Open Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience. Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. #LI-REMOTE *GLSDR #LI-MG1

items.summary: Risk Analyst / Risk Manager â Remote Enterprise Risk | Compliance | Governance | Financial & Operational Risk Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for reporting cycles, audits, and incident response) About the Role At Pavago, weâre hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Risk Analyst / Risk Manager to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate financial, operational, compliance, and enterprise risks across the organization. This is a high-impact role where youâll help safeguard the business by developing risk frameworks, analyzing emerging threats, strengthening internal controls, and delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Youâll work closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Executive Leadership to ensure the organization remains compliant, resilient, and prepared for evolving business risks. If youâre analytical, detail-oriented, and enjoy translating complex risk data into practical business recommendations, this role is built for you. What Youâll OwnEnterprise Risk Assessment Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments across: Financial risk Operational risk Compliance risk Market risk Cybersecurity risk Maintain and update: Risk registers Control matrices Risk assessments Remediation trackers Identify emerging risks and prioritize mitigation activities. Partner with business leaders to strengthen proactive risk management practices. Risk Modeling & Analytics Build and maintain quantitative risk models using: SQL Excel Python R SAS Perform: Stress testing Scenario analysis Sensitivity analysis Regression analysis Monte Carlo simulations Value at Risk (VaR) modeling Analyze trends, anomalies, and key risk indicators (KRIs). Deliver data-driven recommendations to leadership. Compliance & Regulatory Oversight Support compliance with applicable frameworks such as: SOX Basel III Dodd-Frank GDPR HIPAA PCI-DSS Industry-specific regulations Prepare quarterly and annual compliance reports. Support internal and external audits. Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence. Track remediation activities and regulatory deadlines. Internal Controls & Governance Test and evaluate internal controls. Monitor incidents, exceptions, and risk events through Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms. Support governance committees with reporting and documentation. Partner with IT and Security teams on: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Recommend improvements to governance processes and internal controls. Reporting & Executive Communication Build dashboards and reports using: Power BI Tableau Looker Excel Present risk trends and mitigation recommendations to leadership. Translate technical risk findings into clear business insights. Maintain accurate documentation for executive reporting and audit purposes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with: Finance Operations Compliance Legal IT & Security Executive Leadership Embed risk awareness into business processes. Support continuous improvement of enterprise risk management frameworks. RequirementsMust-Have QualificationsExperience 3+ years of experience in: Risk Management Enterprise Risk Compliance Audit Governance Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. Core Skills Strong proficiency in: SQL Microsoft Excel Data analysis Experience using Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms such as: Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Or similar solutions Strong understanding of: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Internal controls Regulatory compliance Experience creating executive dashboards and risk reports. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have Professional certifications such as: FRM CFA CPA CCEP Experience with: VaR Monte Carlo simulations Stress testing Background in: Financial Services Healthcare SaaS Enterprise Technology Experience supporting board reporting or executive governance committees. Knowledge of: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Experience using: Tableau Power BI Looker What Makes You a Strong Fit Strong analytical and quantitative mindset. Exceptional attention to detail. Able to simplify complex risk concepts for business stakeholders. Proactive in identifying issues before they become significant risks. Strong balance of technical expertise and business judgment. Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Tools & Technologies SQL Microsoft Excel Python R SAS Power BI Tableau Looker Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platforms What a Typical Day Looks Like Review dashboards for emerging operational, financial, or compliance risks. Run quantitative risk analyses and stress tests. Update risk registers and remediation trackers. Test internal controls and validate governance processes. Prepare executive reports and compliance documentation. Collaborate with business teams to strengthen risk mitigation strategies. Track remediation progress and regulatory deadlines. In short: You serve as the organizationâs early-warning systemâidentifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they impact the business. Key Metrics for Success (KPIs) Timely and accurate risk reporting. Internal controls tested and validated on schedule. Early identification and mitigation of business risks. Zero missed regulatory or audit deadlines. High-quality executive reporting and dashboards. Positive audit outcomes and leadership confidence. Why Join Us? Make a direct impact on enterprise risk strategy. Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams. Influence governance, compliance, and operational resilience. Build scalable risk management frameworks. Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities. Clear career progression into: Senior Risk Manager Enterprise Risk Lead Director of Risk & Compliance Chief Risk Officer (CRO) Interview Process Application Review Spark Hire Intro Video (3â5 minutes) Recruiter Interview Practical Assessment (Risk Analysis & Recommendations) Client Interview Offer & Background Verification What Happens After You Apply Right after you apply, youâll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever itâs convenient for you. Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, youâll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds. Donât overthink itâyou can record your video as many times as youâd like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application. Apply Now If youâre a Risk Analyst or Risk Manager who enjoys identifying business risks, strengthening governance, improving compliance, and helping organizations make informed decisions, weâd love to hear from you. Apply today and play a key role in protecting and strengthening a growing business. Please mention the word **IMPRESSIVENESS** and tag RNTIuMTc2LjEyNC4xMDI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTc2LjEyNC4xMDI=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
