items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. About the role We're expanding our Customer Success team and looking for a technically confident Customer Success Manager to partner with our Growth customers across the UK. You'll help brands grow with Bloomreach, get the most from Loomi and the wider product suite, to help turn their goals into measurable results. What our customers achieve depends on how well their data, tracking and integrations are set up to deliver value across our product suite. You won't write integration code or build data pipelines (our consultancy services and partners do that), but you will need to understand how the platform works under the hood, read the data behind a customer's results, have an up to date understanding of the AI landscape - especially in Martech all to work out where our customers need to go next to get maximum value from their relationship with Bloomreach. You'll own a named book of customers using multiple Bloomreach solutions, working within a modern engagement model that combines automated, self-serve and product-led experiences with 1:many programmes and targeted 1:1 sessions when a customer needs them most. You'll be the face of Bloomreach for these customers: a trusted advisor, industry expert, a source of ideas, and the person who understands their setup well enough to connect them with the right resources on our side. You will work remotely from the UK or from our London office. The core of the role These are the skills every CSM in the team uses week to week. We'll teach you Bloomreach, but we need you to bring the foundations. Understand how customer data flows. Know how a customer's events, profiles and product catalogue data reaches Bloomreach (whether that be through web and mobile SDKs, APIs, imports, data warehouse connectors and our Data Hub) and understand how identity is stitched from anonymous visitor to known customer. Use that knowledge to sense-check a customer's setup and any spot gaps for technical experts to investigate before they limit results. Read usage against entitlements. Interpret health, adoption and consumption data (monthly unique visitors, profiles, events, email and SMS volumes) against what a customer has contracted, and be able to explain what this usage means for our customers - are they trending ahead/behind or over and if so, why. Triage problems properly. When something isn't working, work out whether it sits in the data, the configuration or the integration, gather the evidence, and route it to Support, consultancy or a partner with a clear, reproducible description or scope. Explain the numbers. Build and interpret reporting on campaign revenue, conversion, average order value and customer lifetime value. When our numbers and the customer's analytics disagree, dig into tracking, attribution windows and methodology until you can explain the gap and ultimately the story behind the data and insights. Know what's possible, and brief it well. Understand what the platform can do across segmentation, scenarios, channels, personalisation, recommendations and search, so you can recommend realistic use cases and write a clear brief when a Technical or Business Consultant needs to build them. Use AI as a working tool. Use Loomi and other AI tools to analyse, research and draft, with the judgement to check and validate the output, and help customers put AI-driven capabilities to work in their own programmes. Share your Knowledge. Whether it be industry insights, AI releases or use case utilisation, a CSM at Bloomreach should be keen to learn and share knowledge to their customers and colleagues alike. We will teach you Bloomreach but experience and interest in Martech, working with and experimenting with AI and agentic approaches will be key to your success. What you will do Own a named book of Growth customers. Act as each customer's designated CSM and main point of contact for adoption, value, satisfaction and the technical health of their setup. Map Bloomreach to each customer's world. Understand their goals, pain points, data and tech stack, then translate these into clear recommendations and success plans that connect Bloomreach and Loomi capabilities to the outcomes they care about. Be the ideas factory. Bring best practice, use-case inspiration and a point of view on what good looks like. Hand off hands-on configuration, implementation and campaign build to our consultancy services, partner network or Support, with a brief clear enough that work can start without a second round of questions. Deliver engagement at scale. Host and facilitate 1:many programmes such as masterclasses, new-customer mini summits, webinars and customer events, alongside workshops, technical deep dives and consulting sessions for individual customers. Read the signals. Monitor health, adoption, usage and data-quality signals across your book, spot risk and growth signals early, and share them promptly with your Account Manager counterpart. Partner with Account Management. Work closely with Account Managers and Renewal Specialists, bringing adoption, value, usage and relationship context into account and renewal conversations. You own adoption, outcomes and retention; your Account Manager owns commercial growth and executive alignment. Together you make sure every customer experiences one joined-up Bloomreach team. Champion the customer. Capture feedback for our Product teams, including technical gaps and limitations with the evidence behind them. Identify advocates and success stories, and contribute to the programmes, content and playbooks that help the whole segment succeed. What success looks like Customers' data and tracking are set up well enough to support the use cases they want to run, and gaps are spotted and resolved early. Technical issues are triaged quickly and land with the right team to resolve these issues first time. Customers understand how Bloomreach supports their goals and can see progress against them, backed by numbers they trust. Adoption across the platform is healthy and growing, including adoption of new as well well as AI and Agentic-driven capabilities. Customers engage with and value the programmes, events and resources available to them. Risk and growth signals reach the right people early, and customers are retained and satisfied. What you bring Technical foundations 2+ years in a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, marketing technology or digital marketing, ideally as a CSM or Technical Account Manager, or in solutions, implementation, martech operations or agency delivery, where you sat between marketers and technical teams. Hands-on experience with at least one marketing automation, ESP or CDP platform (Bloomreach, Klaviyo, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Emarsys or similar), plus an understanding of the commerce data behind it (catalogue, cart, purchase) from platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce or Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Working knowledge of web tracking and data integration: how events and identifiers are captured, what APIs and data feeds do, and how consent affects what can be tracked. Comfortable with exploring data: Knowledge of SQL or strong spreadsheet skills to sanity-check a number, and familiarity with an analytics or BI tool such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Amplitude or Mixpanel. A working understanding of marketing attribution (last-touch versus multi-touch, lookback windows) and customer segmentation (RFM, cohort, lifecycle). A structured approach to problem-solving: when two systems disagree, you find out why rather than explain it away. Customer and consulting skills Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills: you build trust and rapport quickly, keep relationships strong when much of the engagement is remote, digital or in group settings, and earn credibility with stakeholders from day-to-day practitioners to senior leaders. The ability to quickly understand a customer's business model, priorities and KPIs, and to map solutions to their goals and challenges. Confident presentation and facilitation skills, including explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, from a single-customer workshop to a room or virtual audience. Strong organisation and prioritisation, with the judgement to know where your time will have the most impact across a varied book of customers. Good judgement on when to bring in specialists, and the collaboration skills to work smoothly with Account Management, consultancy, partners, Support and Product. Nice to have Knowledge of a templating language (Jinja, Liquid, AMPscript or Handlebars); basic HTML and CSS for email and web; a customer success platform such as Gainsight; or experience supporting a platform implementation or migration. More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote - United States Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next. We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. Why You’ll Love This Role At Cribl, we're transforming from a flagship-product company into a multi-product powerhouse - and every non-routine business event, whether an acquisition, a product launch, or a go-to-market shift, adds complexity our data, definitions, and reporting weren't built to handle. As the Analytics Business Partner, you're the person who closes that gap - translating a new product or customer into our existing data, systems and reporting: how it connects to what we already have, how value is attributed, how we define and track it going forward. Reporting to the VP of Data & Analytics — part of Cribl's broader Business Operations organization alongside Strategy & Operations and Business Effectiveness — you'll operate horizontally across the business rather than embedding in a single function. This is a high-impact role for a strategist who thrives on ambiguity and builds order from chaos. If you are eager to contribute to a company poised for generational success, we want to hear from you. As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will… Diagnose and Drive the Solution. When a non-routine business event doesn't fit with how we currently track or report on the business, define the solution. Whether a system change, a new process or policy, or a different data model, serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for working with the necessary x-functional teams to get it delivered M&A Integration. When we acquire a company, own and drive how its products and customers fit into our existing reporting and data models, ensuring we can capture the impact of the acquisition post deal close New Product Launch. When we launch a new product, understand how Product defines its success metrics, and make sure our models, definitions, and reporting can track against those metrics post launch Keep Execution Moving. When a change spans across the Data and Analytics team (Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Data Governance), sequence who does what first, own the handoffs between them, catch duplication or gaps before they cost the team time, and push the pace when the event demands it Stand Up the Business Intelligence Council. Establish and run the forum where cross-functional leaders align on key measures, attributes, and hierarchy definitions, and on prioritization across competing data and analytics efforts — and drive it to actual resolution, rather than let it stall as a standing meeting. Know The Business. Maintain a working picture of how GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions operate, knowing who to engage so a project doesn’t start or drift, without the right people engaged. For example, understanding how Product Marketing is positioning a new feature, how it needs to be represented across our applications in partnership with IT, and how Finance will measure its impact, before scoping the data work for it. We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours If You've Got It - We Want It 8+ years in management consulting, in-house strategy, business operations, or business analytics, with a track record of operating in unfamiliar functions and reframing ambiguously-posed questions Fluency across GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions - enough to know that 'customer' may mean something different to Sales than it does to Finance, and to reconcile the difference rather than pick a side You can join multiple tables, write a CTE, and get the aggregation grain right - enough to answer your own question - though hands-on query and dashboard work won't be your primary responsibility in this role Given a reporting issue, you know not to default to a “data-only” answer - you can tell whether the real problem is a system that isn't capturing the right data, a process nobody owns, or a data model that no longer matches the business Ability to flex your communication style as needed - equally fluent giving execs the top-line takeaway and working through the nuances with the operational teams to drive a solution First hand experience ensuring a business’s data and reporting keep up following an acquisition or new product launch - designing and driving the solution so the business doesn’t lose visibility into itself Bonus: experience inside a post-close M&A integration, a new product introduction, or a go-to-market model change Bonus: experience in late-stage B2B SaaS startups (i.e., Series E+) and / or early public B2B SaaS companies (e.g., 3-5k employees) #LI-JB1 #LI-Remote The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program. In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity. Base Salary Range $190,000 — $255,000 USD Bring Your Whole Self Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-analytics-business-partner

THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH We’re hiring a Sr. Data Scientist to show the impact our work has for customers. You’ll measure how each engagement moves customers’ pipeline and renewals, build the value analysis customers and leadership rely on, and work hands-on with the senior data scientists on customer models. This role sits where analytics meets modeling. It suits someone who wants to see the business outcome of their work and grow into a forward-deployed data scientist. What You’ll Do Build for the customer Set a baseline for every engagement before work starts, then track the results: account health, renewal outcome, and how predictive scores perform for the customer’s sales team. Measure how scored accounts perform against unscored ones: close rate, sales cycle length and deal size. Assess the impact of model and configuration changes on model performance, qualified-account volume and pipeline timing. Run before-and-after and holdout-style analyses that separate a change’s real effect from noise. Work on live engagements with the senior data scientists: validate account lists, compare a customer’s CRM fields with 6sense firmographic data, and help tailor and tune models. Productize for everyone Build value analysis Data Science can run for any customer on demand, such as qualified-account efficiency, deal journeys and conversion by score bucket. Build the dashboards and reporting the team, Customer Success and leadership use to follow engagement outcomes. What You’ll Bring Required: 5+ years in data science or advanced analytics, with experience building models and measuring business outcomes. Strong SQL and Python, and experience turning messy data into analysis people trust, including matching records across systems by ID. Solid grounding in statistics and experiment design: baselines, control groups, and knowing when a difference is real. Experience building dashboards or reporting for business stakeholders. Clear communicator who can explain what the numbers mean, and what they don’t. Comfortable switching between several projects at once. Nice to have: B2B go-to-market or SaaS customer data (CRM, renewals, pipeline, customer health); a customer-facing, consulting or analytics-for-clients role; BI tools such as Tableau; data platforms such as SingleStore, Snowflake or Hive. What Success Looks Like In 3 months: every active engagement has a documented baseline and an agreed success measure. In 6 months: leadership reviews engagement results from reporting you built, and you’ve contributed to at least one customer model. In 12 months: the team can show the business value of its work across all engagements, and you’re leading data science work on engagements of your own. Why this role is different: you see the business outcome of the work directly, and you’re the one who shows customers and leadership what it’s worth. It’s also a direct path into forward-deployed data science. Base Salary Range: $168,349.50 - $230,912.60. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. items.description: As a Senior Data Analyst, Executive Analytics at Namecheap and Spaceship, you will be the go-to analyst for the C-level of both brands and for our board. You will take open-ended questions from leadership, figure out what's really being asked, get the data yourself and come back with a clear recommendation, which you will present yourself. This is a brand-new role: you will define the exec analytics function and the board reporting standard from day one, and your conclusions will go straight to the people making the decisions. Location: 100% remote from Europe (CET ±2h), B2B contract! Interview Process: 5 stages - 30 min intro call -> 1h conversation with the Head of BI -> 1h technical interview -> take-home case (up to 5h) -> 1h case presentation Tools: SQL (BigQuery, MSSQL, MySQL, Trino), Python (pandas, notebooks), Tableau, Looker / Looker Studio, Excel / Google Sheets Reporting to: Head of BI Team size: A global BI department of 7 teams, with LLM tools in daily use, and YOU as the dedicated analyst for the C-level and the board! What will make your journey with us amazing? A supportive manager who cares about your well-being and is invested in your professional growth. A culture of continuous learning, with clear targets and feedback. A global company with over 2500 employees located in more than 26 countries around the world, including offices in 3 countries: Ukraine, Portugal, and India. What will you do: You will be the single analytics point of contact for the leadership of two brands at different stages: established Namecheap and fast-growing Spaceship. You will run deep dives on whatever leadership needs answered (pricing, retention, product performance, growth), support FP&A with budgeting, plan vs. actual, financial models and forecasts for both brands, own the executive and board reporting pack on one consistent set of metrics, present your findings to the C-level and the board, and work on strategic cases like pricing changes, new products and M&A. What will you bring: You will have 5-8 years of experience in analytics, with real experience in SaaS, subscription or e-commerce You will be skilled in SQL across several engines and build your own data marts (we use BigQuery, MSSQL, MySQL and Trino, but you don't need hands-on experience with all of them) You have experience with Python for analysis, solid statistics and A/B testing You have working experience with forecasting: time series and cohort models You are experienced with financial modeling in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable with unit economics You have domain expertise in subscription metrics (retention, LTV), pricing and product analytics You have working experience with Tableau and/or Looker / Looker Studio You turn a vague question into a sharp one, and numbers into a decision You can point to analyses that changed a business decision, with the numbers to prove it You have fluent English (C1+) and are confident presenting to senior leadership Experience with Trino or federated queries, dbt, LLM tools in your analytics workflow, or a background in domains, hosting or web infrastructure is a plus What’s in it for you: Embrace work-life balance with a 100% remote role. Get a direct line to the C-level and the board, where your work changes decisions. Work across two brands with different economics and different problems. Grow with a path to leading exec analytics. Participate in team-building activities and events. Utilize the best tools and technology for work, including LLM tools. #NamecheapCareers #SpaceshipCareers #HackYourCareer #equalopportunity Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams About You You likely have: Expert-level proficiency in Snowflake, dbt, and Python for data modeling, transformation, pipeline development, and advanced analytics Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, large-scale data model design, and database optimization Proven experience architecting, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Hands-on administration of cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud A strong understanding of secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Mastery of version control (Git, GitHub) and structured workflow management (Jira) for code review, audit trails, and operational transparency A demonstrated ability to automate and simplify complex manual tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components Dependability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to engineering, thriving in dynamic and ambiguous environments Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Hands-on experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, delivering technical solutions under shifting priorities A background supporting business intelligence, analytics, and data science teams through large-scale integrations and multi-tenant reporting Familiarity with both batch and event-driven ingestion paradigms, including near-real-time pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, and Python Experience automating operational, financial, or compliance-driven workflows within cloud data environments Exposure to audit, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, and SOX, particularly in data governance and secure access controls Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, healthtech, or SaaS Why This Role Matters Reliable data is the foundation of how Carrot operates, from the analytics that guide business decisions to the reporting our customers and partners depend on. The systems this role owns determine the accuracy, recency, and security of data used across the entire company. As Carrot scales globally, the Sr. Data Engineer will make our data platform more automated, resilient, and cost-efficient, enabling teams across the business to move faster with data they trust. This work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows
items.description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress. How we work Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated: Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress. If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit. Want to learn more? Read and listen: We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We’re now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO’s essay on what that will take. About this role GiveDirectly gives cash directly to people living in poverty and in emergencies. Both depend on the same question: did this person live in this place, at this time? We ask it when we target the poorest households, and when a disaster displaces a community overnight. Location records held by Mobile Network Operators (MNO) can help us estimate an answer to this question at scale. We work with MNOs so they can infer, from their own records, whether a subscriber was resident in a target area over a defined period. Robust residence location inference from MNO data requires in-depth analytical work, and the methods we design have to run on an operator’s systems - most often implemented by their engineers - under strict data protection and confidentiality rules. We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to progress our work on location inference from MNO data, and to make it repeatable. Your job is to improve and extend our library of method templates, adapt them to each new operator and setting, and design new elements when an intervention requires it. You’ll assess what can be inferred from a given operator’s data, specify the analysis clearly enough for their data engineers to implement, then test it with them remotely or on site. You’ll support introductory meetings with MNOs, describing methodologies at a high level, and inform the work of data privacy and cybersecurity teams to ensure only necessary data are shared securely. You’ll also help colleagues across GiveDirectly understand the strengths and limitations of this data source, so we design programs around questions it can best answer. This work is live in several countries, and we’re expanding it across the countries where we have offices and to low- and middle-income countries anywhere in the world when a crisis hits. Reports to: Senior Product Manager - MNO data Level : Senior Manager Location: At this stage of GiveDirectly’s growth and scale, we’re prioritizing hiring in the countries below, where we can employ you through a GD entity or an established employer of record: Cameroon, Canada, Colombia, DRC, Germany, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Netherlands, Nigeria, Poland, Portugal, Rwanda, South Africa, Spain, Turkey, Uganda, United Kingdom, and United States. This list reflects where our employment infrastructure is established today, and may evolve as we grow. If you’re based elsewhere and not open to relocation, we may not be able to consider your application for this role right now, but we’d encourage you to check back. Please note that we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time. Travel Requirement: Substantial international travel, roughly 25 to 50% of your time depending on emergencies, sometimes at short notice - for workshops with operators to support programs and emergency responses. What you’ll do: Improve and extend our library of analytical method templates for establishing where people live from MNO data, and depending on circumstances, for detecting displacement or estimating poverty. Design novel methods when an intervention requires it. Support colleagues in technical conversations with operators, bringing clarity on the data we need and why, and steering discussions toward technical designs that make the analysis workable. Assess the information that can be inferred from each operator’s data given data types and sparsity, and for each geography and targeted area. Support intervention design to account for data quality. Write tests and method specifications for MNO data engineers to implement: steps, parameters, pseudocode, validation criteria. Guide operator engineering teams through implementation, in writing and in person. Adapt methods to accommodate large data volume and computational constraints, balancing accuracy and operational needs. Run in-country workshops with operators to support the set-up of new analyses and - where feasible - tune parameters based on statistical tests and distributions. Feed every new analytical and implementation element back into standard templates, so the next country or intervention starts from a better position than the last. Design for privacy from the start, so that as little data as possible has to be shared: aggregation, minimization, and where useful, privacy-enhancing technologies such as private set intersection or homomorphic encryption. Protect the confidentiality of what operators share with us and improve internal data security processes and tools as we grow. Build internal training material so that our technical and non-technical teams understand the strengths and limits of this data, and design interventions accordingly. What you’ll bring: Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve. Strong mathematical modeling, machine learning and statistics. You choose methods for the question rather than for their sophistication, and you value being able to explain a result over squeezing out the last point of performance. Deep comfort with spatio-temporal data: temporal filtering, GIS, probability distributions, combinatorial reasoning, and working with sparse, irregular observations. Direct experience with Call Detail Records (CDRs) or latching data is a strong plus. Comparable experience with mobility, transport, sensor or remote-sensing data counts. The ability to reason without ground truth. Much of this work has no validated answer to check against, and you’re comfortable setting parameters by reading the shape of the data and defending that choice. Pragmatism about the trade-off between accuracy and implementability. You’ve deliberately simplified a method to fit an operational constraint, and you can say what it cost you. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. You can explain a method and its limitations to an operator’s engineers, to their data protection officer, to their leadership and to colleagues with or without technical background. You write well and are comfortable presenting to these multiple audiences. You build trust with counterparts you don’t manage, and they want to work with you again. Experience writing technical specifications that other teams implemented, clear enough that people you don’t manage could follow them correctly. Able to read and review SQL and Python written by others, and to find the logical error in someone else’s query. Writing production-quality code yourself is welcome but not required. Enough understanding of large data volumes and databases to judge when analytical simplification is required. Commitment to privacy by design as a foundational value and starting point rather than a compliance step: designing analyses so that less personal data has to be shared. Familiarity with privacy-enhancing technologies for shared computation (private set intersection, secure multi-party computation, homomorphic encryption) is a strong plus. Commitment to confidentiality. You’ve handled a partner’s commercially sensitive data and can describe the habits you built around it, not just the clause you signed. Experience designing training material that changed how non-specialist colleagues used a data source. Comfort in fast-moving contexts where the brief may often shift, and where your technical expertise and understanding may not be shared by other stakeholders. Additional desirable experience may include: poverty modeling; familiarity with survey data and survey instruments; experience inside a mobile network operator or working closely with one; open-source contributions in the mobility estimation space. Comfortable with travel to fragile and post-disaster contexts. Language Requirement: English. Language Preferences: French, Portuguese, Swahili or Spanish. Compensation At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here . Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income. United State Base Salary: $107,070 Bonus at Target Performance: 10% Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393 United Kingdom Base Salary: £70,250 Bonus at Target Performance: 10% Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760 Kenya Base Salary: $72,550 Bonus at Target Performance: 10% Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454 This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process. #LI-REMOTE Working at GiveDirectly GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to “Know Your Rights” as an applicant. Commitment to Safeguarding As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens. These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff. **GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.** Reasonable Accommodations We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs. Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide ! Referrals Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them . We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

items.title: Lead Generation Strategy and Operations
items.summary: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of…
items.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for someone to join our team in Lead Generation Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision. As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment. In this role, you will be responsible for: E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Events, Partner) to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness. Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting. Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area. Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across pre-sales functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement. Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance. Who you are We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you: Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech. Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead. Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset. Consistently strive for excellence , delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations. Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside. What you bring 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution. Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma) Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement. Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Media Buyer
items.summary: Our client, Jugabet, is a brand and gaming platform accessible to players in Latin America.
items.description: Our client, Jugabet, is a brand and gaming platform accessible to players in Latin America. With a strong regional focus and localized strategies, Jugabet is quickly becoming a key player in the market. Perfect for those who aim to: Plan, launch, and scale ad campaigns on Facebook and TikTok (Google UAC is a plus) targeting relevant iGaming audiences in Mexico; Build and continuously refine the audience layer: Look-A-Like and Custom audiences based on depositors, high-value players, and in-app events; Design and run retargeting funnels across the full path (install, registration, first deposit, etc.); Launch and optimize ROAS / value-based campaigns (value optimization, tROAS); Manage ad accounts for the long run: respect the learning phase, control creative fatigue cycles, scale incrementally, and keep performance stable over months instead of restarting from scratch; Own the app acquisition funnel: deep links, in-app event mapping, and passing deposit events back to Meta and TikTok via CAPI / server-side tracking; Optimize toward cohort economics, not just front-end CPA: work with D7/D30 ROAS, retention, and player LTV together with the CRM and retention teams; Analyze campaign data, build performance reports, and identify improvement areas across every platform (experience with Tableau or Power BI is a plus); Collaborate with creative and content teams to develop l ocalized ad assets for Regulated Market — language, cultural context, and seasonality; Conduct structured A/B testing (creatives, audiences, bidding strategies) to improve performance and engagement; Stay on top ofMeta and TikTok gambling ad policies and platform updates that affect the vertical; Monitor competitors and market trends across paid social to spot new opportunities. Experience you’ll need to bring: 2+ years of hands-on media buying on Facebook and TikTok (Google UAC is a plus), with a proven track record in regulated LATAM iGaming markets; Experience promoting products on white / regulated iGaming markets — or a strong background in white niches (mobile apps, gaming) with a clear understanding of platforms compliance; Confident work with Facebook Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager: campaign structure, Advantage+/ASC, bidding strategies, CBO/ABO budget distribution; Hands-on experience building and testing Look-A-Like and Custom audiences, with a clear sense of which source audiences actually scale; Experience with retargeting in Facebook: funnel logic, audiences, exclusions, and creative sequencing; Experience launching and scaling ROAS-based campaigns and understanding how conversion data quality drives algorithm performance; Understanding of how FB/TikTok algorithms behave over time: learning phase, signal quality, creative fatigue, incremental scaling instead of aggressive edits; Solid setup of tracking and attribution: Pixel, CAPI / server-side events, deep links, AppsFlyer / Adjust, S2S postbacks, Voluum or similar trackers; Comfortable with app-based acquisition: WebView / iOS / Android apps, MMP configuration, in-app event tracking; Understanding of core metrics: CPM, CPC, CTR, CPI, CPR, CPD, CPA, ROAS / ROMI, plus retention and LTV of acquired players; Experience working with budgets from $50,000+ per month, with a demonstrated ability to scale while keeping CPA profitable; Working knowledge of Meta and TikTok gambling policies: licensed advertiser setup, whitelisting, and healthy ad account structure; Upper-Intermediate level of English. It's a perfect match if you have those personal features: Analytical & Data-Driven mindset: enjoys diving into numbers, spotting trends, and making performance-based decisions; Detail-Oriented: carefully monitors campaign metrics, budgets, and compliance to avoid costly mistakes; Proactive & Results-Oriented: takes initiative, owns performance, and is constantly looking for ways to improve ROMI; Strong Communication & Collaboration Skills: able to clearly communicate ideas, strategies, and results within the team, works well with cross-functional teams (creative, product, CRM, compliance) to hit shared goals. Our clients offer competitive benefits to support your professional and personal growth, including: Health & Wellness Focus; Global Medical Coverage; Growth Opportunities; Benefits Programs (compensation for the gym/stomatology/psychological service Performance-Driven Rewards; Dynamic Work Environment. Apply, and let your growth journey begin. Originally posted on Himalayas
