items.description: WHO WE ARE We’re Hook, an award-winning creative content agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we make ads, campaigns, and experiences that drive growth for the world’s most innovative brands. Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet. THE ROLE We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer who lives in TypeScript. You write clean, well-typed, well-tested TypeScript on both sides of the stack — React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js services and APIs on the back end — and you deploy and operate what you build on Google Cloud or AWS. As a Principal Engineer, you’ll own Hook’s internal applications and platform end to end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and long-term health. You’re self-directed, comfortable owning complex products from first idea through continued development, and you make confident architectural decisions without needing a roadmap handed to you. When a client project needs a strong technical lead, you step in with that same ownership mindset. OUR STACK Language: TypeScript, end to end Front end: React, Next.js Back end: Node.js, Express (or similar: Fastify, NestJS, Hono), REST and GraphQL APIs Cloud: Google Cloud Platform and AWS (serverless, containers, managed databases, queues, storage), plus Vercel Data: PostgreSQL / relational databases and document stores (Firestore, MongoDB, or similar) Tooling: Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), modern TypeScript tooling (Vite, Vitest/Jest, ESLint, pnpm/npm workspaces) AI: LLM APIs and AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) WHAT YOU’LL DO Architect, build, and ship production full-stack web applications in TypeScript, from React/Next.js front ends to Node.js services and APIs Design and own back-end services, APIs, and integrations with third-party platforms Deploy, operate, and monitor applications on Google Cloud or AWS, including infrastructure, CI/CD, task queues, observability, security, and cost Own product areas end to end: problem discovery, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement Partner with creative, production, and operations teams to understand their workflows and turn them into reliable, well-designed software Integrate AI capabilities (LLM APIs, agents, automation) into the applications you build Set the technical bar: drive code review, testing standards, documentation, and best practices Serve as technical lead on select client web projects and occasionally direct freelance developers Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and approaches as Hook’s needs evolve WHAT YOU’LL NEED 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years writing production TypeScript/JavaScript as your primary language Expert-level TypeScript: advanced types and generics, strict-mode codebases, type-safe API contracts, and a strong grasp of the JavaScript runtime (event loop, async patterns, modules, gotchas) Deep Node.js experience: building and maintaining production HTTP APIs and back-end services with Express or a comparable framework, including auth, validation, error handling, background jobs, and performance Deep React expertise: component architecture, hooks, state management, data fetching, and performance optimization for complex, highly interactive, multi-user applications, CSS solutions Production Next.js experience: App Router, server components, server-side rendering, routing, and caching Strong hands-on Google Cloud Platform or AWS experience — you have personally deployed and operated production applications, not just consumed them. For example: GCP: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, IAM AWS: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM Containers and delivery: Docker for development and production, CI/CD pipelines, and environment/secrets management Databases: strong SQL (PostgreSQL or similar) and working knowledge of document databases, including schema design and query performance Testing discipline: unit, integration, and end-to-end testing (e.g., Vitest/Jest, Playwright) as a normal part of how you ship Software engineering fundamentals: you write secure, reliable, maintainable code and make well-reasoned architectural trade-offs without over-engineering AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot fluently, while remaining the expert owner of system design and code quality Clear communication: you can explain architecture to engineers and the same ideas, plainly, to creatives, producers, and clients Ownership and autonomy: you thrive with ambiguity, set your own direction, and see work through to production and beyond NICE TO HAVE Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) Experience building internal tools, workflow automation, or developer/creative productivity platforms Familiarity with plugin or extension development for creative tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe UXP) — in TypeScript Python or Bash for scripting and automation Experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, or AI-powered product features Experience working in an agency, studio, or other creatively driven, fast-paced environment Open-source contributions WHAT ELSE Qualified applicants will include a resume, a statement of interest that lets us learn a little more about you, and code samples — a link to your public GitHub or other examples of your work. Please include TypeScript work (React/Next.js and/or Node.js) where possible. Be prepared to discuss your code in depth as part of the interview process. At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us! Hook believes in compensation transparency and equity. We’ve designed a 10-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments and aligns to location-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as L7. During the interview process we’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. Please follow this link to learn more. Please review our Transparent Compensation Philosophy. We are not currently considering candidates in the Tier 4 market band for this role at this time.

items.title: Solutions Engineer
items.summary: Consequential Work. Dedicated People. About Onebrief Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production. Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real. You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment. What You'll Do Core responsibilities: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments. Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments. Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline. Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables. Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards. Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options. Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales. Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering. Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises. Minimum Qualifications Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. items.description: About Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing to join our Data Intelligence team and build the measurement foundation that tells us what's actually working across paid and PLG channels. You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, and channel owners, helping us move past platform-reported metrics and vanity numbers into causal, trusted answers about what drives pipeline and revenue. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, is AI-forward in how they work, and is excited about building a measurement function from the ground up. What You'll Be Responsible for Marketing Measurement Strategy Own the end-to-end marketing measurement strategy across experimentation, media mix modeling, and attribution for paid and PLG channels Establish and evolve the attribution framework: how platform data, multi-touch attribution, MMM, and experiments work together to inform decisions Translate complex measurement outputs into clear recommendations on where to invest, what to cut, and how to hit pipeline, revenue, and efficiency targets (CAC, payback, LTV to CAC) Serve as the subject matter expert for marketing measurement, educating stakeholders on causality, model uncertainty, and the limitations of platform-reported metrics Incrementality and Experimentation Design and run always-on incrementality tests, user-level and geo-level, to quantify the causal impact of key channels, campaigns, and tactics Calculate incremental lift, incrementality percent, and incremental ROAS/CPA, and use these to guide budget reallocation Build repeatable analysis templates and playbooks for experiment design, analysis, and readouts so results are consistent across teams Partner with channel owners (paid search, paid social, lifecycle, website/SEO) to build and prioritize a experimentation roadmap, embedding it into campaign planning, creative testing, and audience strategy Media Mix Modeling and Forecasting Build and maintain media mix models using historical data to estimate channel contribution, marginal returns, and optimal budget allocation Incorporate seasonality, adstock, and saturation effects, and continuously validate model performance through backtesting and reconciliation with experiment results Turn MMM insights into budget scenarios and forecasts across channels and regions, communicated in a way non-technical stakeholders can act on Context, Tooling, and Data Integrity Own and build the context and skills that let marketing teams run accurate self-serve analytics: metric definitions, model documentation, and reusable analysis patterns, not just dashboards Use AI tools as a core part of daily work to accelerate analysis and go deeper than a traditional analyst workflow allows, and help establish AI-forward practices across the marketing org Identify gaps and inconsistencies in marketing data (tracking, spend, platform exports) and work cross-functionally to fix them at the root rather than patching around them downstream You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 6+ years in marketing analytics, data science, or a related role, with a focus on performance marketing and/or PLG growth Deeply understand marketing attribution, incrementality testing, and media mix modeling, and how they complement each other rather than compete Are advanced in SQL and at least one statistical programming language (Python or R) for experiment analysis and modeling Have hands-on experience designing, running, and interpreting experiments across digital marketing channels: search, social, display, email, in-product Have built or worked closely with MMM and/or advanced attribution models, ideally in a consumption or BaaS environment Have strong business acumen and fluency in growth metrics: CAC, LTV, payback period, conversion rates, funnel performance Think in terms of self-service and scale: your instinct is to build tools and frameworks that make marketing teams independently capable, not to become the bottleneck for every "did this work" question Can hold technical and strategic context at once: you're as comfortable in a model's residuals as you are in a conversation about budget tradeoffs Are AI-forward in how you work: you use LLMs and AI tooling habitually and have a clear point of view on how it changes what an analyst can do Communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders and know how to make causal nuance land in a business conversation Thrive in async, autonomous environments and are energized by building a measurement function from the ground up Nice to Haves Experience in BaaS, DevRel or open source dev tool companies, connecting marketing spend to pipeline and revenue outcomes Experience with applied econometrics, time-series modeling, or Bayesian methods for MMM and experimentation Familiarity with common marketing and analytics tools (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, web analytics, CDPs, BI/visualization tools) What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

items.description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. The Manager of Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) for APAC is a leadership role combining people management, high-touch client engagement, and deep technical expertise in the programmatic advertising ecosystem. Reporting to the VP of Global Data & Analytics, you will lead the APAC Client Analytics Partnership team delivering strategic client reporting, advanced data insights, and custom measurement solutions across APAC regions. This role is highly client-facing and relationship-driven . As a trusted measurement consultant, you will partner directly with key client executives, lead strategic discovery workshops, and translate complex business goals into sophisticated, data-driven analytics frameworks. You will also bring strong technical depth and comprehensive mastery of programmatic media and adtech measurement to hands-on support for high-priority strategic partnerships. StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, for this position, we are prioritizing candidates based in Singapore to enable regular, in-person collaboration with key regional clients and partners. What you will be doing: Lead and mentor the Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) team across APAC, establishing strategic goals and fostering team development. Serve as the primary measurement consultant for Sales and Client Service leads, driving executive-level conversations across APAC enterprise accounts and agency holdcos. Provide technical guidance and direct support on high-priority client partnerships, measurement testing plans, learning agendas, and custom attribution frameworks. Translate complex regional analytics requirements to scaled solutions teams and product team to build scalable, high-impact client deliverables and data pipelines. Help support recruitment and GTM of prioritised initiatives to feed the pipeline of potential case study candidates. Collaborate with NORAM analytics leads to build enterprise-level measurement tactics, ensure efficient cross-regional project alignment, and represent APAC market needs globally. Advises on measurement strategy and planning in key new business development, and directly participates in client pitches. Represent APAC market needs to identify region-specific nuances in GTM materials. What you’ll bring to the table: 6+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, or data insights roles within adtech, media, or digital marketing. Deep programmatic expertise with proven mastery in multi-channel campaign measurement, DSP/SSP data structures, and translating raw programmatic data into strategic business recommendations. Knowledge of regional ad policies and guardrails on privacy and data governance laws. Strong technical depth with proficiency in data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, advanced Excel), with the ability to interface effectively with data architects and engineering teams. Proven client-facing experience partnering with major media agency holding companies and enterprise advertisers across complex multi-market environments. Exceptional data storytelling and executive communication skills, with a track record of influencing C-suite and senior marketing decision-makers. People management experience or a strong track record as a player-coach leading cross-functional strategic initiatives. Deep understanding of measurement methodologies and strategies , including incrementality, brand and engagement lift, test design, attribution models (including the limitations of last-touch attribution and application of multi-touch attribution), and marketing mix modelling (MMM). The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. Factors Influencing Final Compensation: The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications. Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer. Base Salary Band $172,160—$236,720 SGD StackAdapter's Enjoy: Highly competitive salary Retirement/ 401K/ Pension Savings globally Competitive Paid time off packages including birthday's off! Access to a comprehensive mental health care program Health benefits from day one of employment Work from home reimbursements Optional global WeWork membership for those who want a change from their home office and hubs in London and Toronto Robust training and onboarding program Coverage and support of personal development initiatives (conferences, courses, books etc) Access to StackAdapt programmatic courses and certifications to support continuous learning An awesome parental leave program A friendly, welcoming, and supportive culture Our social and team events! Please note: Benefits and perks may vary depending on your country of employment and the nature of your engagement. In locations where StackAdapt does not have a legal entity, employment and benefits are administered in accordance with local regulations and partner policies. StackAdapt is a diverse and inclusive team of collaborative, hardworking individuals trying to make a dent in the universe. No matter who you are, where you are from, who you love, follow in faith, disability, superpower status, ethnicity, or the gender you identify with (if you’re comfortable, let us know your pronouns), you are welcome at StackAdapt. StackAdapt is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions. We've been awarded: G2 Top Software for 2026 2026 Best Workplaces™ for Young Talent and in Canada by Great Place to Work® #1 DSP on G2 and leader in a number of categories including Cross-Channel Advertising 2026 Winner in the (CTV/OTT) Product/Platform category for the 2026 ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards To learn more about our privacy practices, please see our Privacy Policy . #LI-REMOTE

items.title: Global Meal Coordinator
items.summary: ABOUT ECHO ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization.
items.description: ABOUT ECHO ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization. Our mission is to strengthen the capacity of a diverse global network to defeat hunger and improve lives through sustainable food and agroecosystem strategies. ECHO has a significant network of over 20,000 individuals and organizations built over 45 years working in more than 190 countries. These partners serve as the primary multiplier for ECHO tested options, strategies, and research. WHY JOIN ECHO At ECHO, you will join a global Christian network committed to defeating hunger and restoring hope through sustainable agriculture. Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to equipping leaders around the world with practical tools that create lasting impact. If you are passionate about faith-integrated service and sustainable solutions, you will find meaningful purpose in this role. SUMMARY: The Global Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Coordinator is part of the Global MEAL team and contributes to ECHO’s development and roll-out of a Global MEAL system to foster the growth of a learning organization. The role helps ensure timely, accurate and useful program information is collected, analyzed and communicated through ECHO’s reporting processes, with reports reviewed and approved by the appropriate directors and executives. The role will contribute to the collection of quantitative data and qualitative stories to track progress on ECHO’s Strategic Framework Logframe indicators. This role requires a curious, proactive self-starter who gets excited about supporting our organization to move beyond a compliance attitude towards reporting on what happened, to always asking more questions on why and how change did or did not happen and what that means for strategic decision-making. This is a support role with room for initiative and independent work under the direction of the Global MEAL Lead; it does not carry decision-making authority. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Growing a Learning Organization: Assist the Global MEAL Lead in improving ECHO’s global MEAL practices. Support teams at Regional Impact Centers to implement their learning agendas by contributing to their MEAL planning, tool development and activity planning. Document emerging results, lessons and stories of change for reporting and learning. Proactively participate in the Impact Learning Circles and engage in outcome harvesting and mapping exercises on a continuous basis. Facilitate regular reflection on monitoring and evaluation findings with program and regional teams. Regular Monitoring and Reporting: Support MEAL coordinators and reporting coordinators based at Regional Impact Centers with monthly reporting. Assist in managing the ECHO Kobo Toolbox account, including projects, tools and membership. Review submissions for completeness, consistency and data quality. Consolidate regional data, analyze progress against indicators, targets and annual plans and produce regular data summaries. Format and design reports with a clear layout and visual presentation that make data and stories of change easy to read and use. Support Tracking of Progress Towards Strategic Framework Logframe: Contribute to the development of both qualitative and quantitative tools. Train and assist teams in data collection towards Strategic Framework Logframe indicators, including occasional in-person trainings on site. Contribute to dashboarding and visualization of data. QUALIFICATIONS: Core Skills and Competencies: Technical MEAL Knowledge: Basic quantitative and qualitative monitoring, reporting, data analysis, and evaluation abilities. Relational Project Management: Strong emphasis on prioritizing building relationships above completing tasks with strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to flexibly manage multiple tasks independently. Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and collaborate in a cross-cultural, team-oriented environment, making complex ideas simple and attainable. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, other languages such as Thai, French, Spanish or Kiswahili are an added advantage. Data Protection and Safeguarding: Experience with data protection and safeguarding, and a commitment to upholding the dignity of communities and community members in how data, stories, and images are collected, stored, and shared. Learning attitude: A proactive self-starter with a demonstrated commitment to long-term personal growth and professional development, and to building advanced MEAL capacity and skills through this role as a step toward broader professional aspirations. Preferred Qualifications: Technical proficiency: Experience with Microsoft Sharepoint, experience with Kobo Toolbox as a data collection tool and PowerBI as a data visualization tool. Report design: Demonstrated skill in the formatting, layout, and design of reports, so that data and stories of change are clear, accurate, and engaging for varied audiences. Contextual knowledge: Experience with approaches to community-led MEAL approaches and holistic flourishing frameworks, such as the Light Wheel. Experience in the fields of food security, nutrition, agriculture, adult learning, or training is preferred. Additional Requirements: Must adhere to the ECHO Statement of Faith and possess character traits consistent with ECHO’s Core Values. REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Education: A bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., social sciences or information systems) is required. Experience: A minimum of 1 year of experience in MEAL practices in an NGO or foundation organizational setting. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS: Positions Directly Supervised: This position has no direct reports. Those Directly Supported: Regional Impact Center staff, all MEAL staff and contributors. Others to Work Closely With: Advancement, Communications, Global Support Services, Department Managers, and the directors and executives who review and approve reports. WORK ENVIRONMENT: Primarily a computer-based office or remote work environment. There are occasional times when work is conducted in an outdoor or field office (international and domestic) setting, such as during site visits and trainings, which may involve hot and humid conditions. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position is almost exclusively computer-based and requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods and to communicate effectively in person and through virtual platforms. Occasional travel and on-site, in-person trainings may require standing or walking for periods of time. POSITION TYPE AND EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work may vary based on organizational needs. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and accommodate time zone differences. WORK LOCATION: This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or at an ECHO Regional Impact Center, depending on organizational needs and position requirements. Candidates may be based in various countries, with a preference for those located in the Asia region . TRAVEL: Travel domestically and internationally may involve up to 10% of time annually. OTHER DUTIES: Undertake additional tasks as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and responsiveness to the organizational needs. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Paid Time Off (PTO) Paid Holidays Health Insurance with Monthly Employer Contribution Retirement Plan with Monthly Matching Employer Contribution Phone Stipend AAP/EEO STATEMENT: ECHO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe it is our moral and legal obligation to meet the responsibility of ensuring that all management practices regarding employees are conducted in a nondiscriminatory manner. In compliance with Title VII of the 1964 Civil Rights Act, and other applicable federal and state statutes, all recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting for all job classifications will be administered without regard to race, color, ancestry, age, sex, national origin, pregnancy or childbirth, disability, military veteran status, genetic information, or other applicable status protected by law, including state of employment protected classes. It is, therefore, our policy and intention to evaluate all employees and prospective employees strictly according to the requirements of the job. ECHO is a Christian religious-affiliated organization; and as such, is not subject to religious discrimination requirements. ECHO’s hiring practices and EEO discrimination practices are in full compliance with both federal and state law. Federal law creates an exception to the “religion” component of the employment discrimination laws for religious organizations and permits them to give employment practice preference to members of their own religious beliefs. #LinkedIn Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The institution generates a great deal of information and data across campuses, programmes and systems held by functions with different definitions and different reporting rhythms. The Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will assemble it, identify what matters in it and put that in front of the people who have to decide. You are expected to find the insight inside fragmented institutional information and make it usable by the people who have to act on it. This role goes beyond producing analysis to deciding what the analysis means, what can reasonably be concluded from it, and the form in which that meaning will actually land. The role will enable the University to act on what its own information is telling it by bringing together fragmented evidence, establishing what matters and putting it in front of the right person in a form they can use. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Research, Economic Analysis and Insight (the core of the role) Produce quantitative and economic analysis underpinning material submitted to the Executive Committee and the Board including scenario work, unit economics, capacity and cost modelling, cost behaviour, and the baseline scenario against which a decision should be judged. Take fragmentary, inconsistent and incomplete inputs from several functions and produce one defensible view, with the areas of remaining uncertainty named rather than smoothed over. This is the central skill of the role. Interrogate the question behind the request. Where the question as asked will not produce a useful answer, clarify the decision that needs to be supported and propose the more useful analytical question. Maintain relevant external evidence, including comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research and precedent relevant to current analyses and decisions. Build and maintain the external evidence base: comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research, and precedent relevant to decisions in front of ALU . State assumptions explicitly, and state plainly what an analysis does not establish. Where required data does not exist, publish the gap rather than substituting a proxy without saying so. Review recurring analysis and underlying assumptions, identify material gaps or inconsistencies, and raise findings where further scrutiny is required. Communication and Decision-Ready Output Design data and insight presentations so the key finding is immediately visible rather than presenting the dataset in full. Treat chart selection, sequencing and emphasis as analytical choices. Determine the appropriate format for each piece of work, whether a written memo, one-page decision brief, chart, dashboard, model walkthrough or verbal briefing, based on the decision, audience and complexity involved. Write for senior readers with limited time: lead with the finding or decision required, support it with the relevant evidence, and state what remains unknown and what would resolve it. Adjust the level of detail, language and presentation across audiences including the Executive Committee, Board, departmental leaders and technical counterparts. Present analysis clearly and confidently, including the assumptions, limitations and implications of the work. Automation and tooling Support the development and maintenance of automated workflows for data extraction, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, reducing recurring manual effort. Use AI-enabled tools, agents and scripted workflows to accelerate recurring analytical tasks, including drafting, summarisation, exception detection, data preparation and scheduled checks. Apply judgement to AI-generated outputs, validate results and identify where automation should not replace human review. Build and maintain escalation triggers within recurring analytical and monitoring processes so that exceptions, overdue actions or material changes generate timely alerts. Document analytical tools and workflows to a standard that allows another team member to operate, understand and modify them without reliance on the original author. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Improve analytical methodologies, templates, reporting processes and tools used by the Business Performance & Analysis function. Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardised, automated or redesigned. Establish practical quality checks for recurring analysis and reporting. Share analytical methods, tools and lessons learned across the team and support the development of analytical capability. Performance Tracking and Follow-through Maintain accurate records of key decisions, actions, owners, assumptions and review dates arising from performance and planning activities. Monitor agreed actions and escalation triggers and raise overdue or off-track items appropriately through appropriate and well suited digital tools. Maintain the document repository to support continuity, transparency and effective handover. Executive and cycle coordination Coordinate engagement requirements against the University's planning, review and reporting calendar, including committee dates, planning cycles, statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. Prepare the analysis, briefing material and supporting information required for those engagements. Track actions and commitments arising from key meetings and ensure they are reflected in the appropriate working records and follow-up mechanisms. Coordinate inputs across functions to ensure materials are complete, consistent and ready for review. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 6 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience producing analysis that informs decisions taken by people more senior than yourself, in a research institution, consultancy, financial institution, policy body, university, or comparable analytical function. Economic reasoning, evidenced by training or by practice. You think in terms of opportunity cost, marginal effects, incentives and counterfactuals, and you state your assumptions before your conclusions. A degree in economics or experience across consulting, policy research, financial analysis or a quantitative discipline. Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into concise executive communication, including decision briefs, presentations, dashboards or written recommendations. Working competence in Python or R for data analysis and evidence of having built or supported an analytical workflow that can run with limited manual intervention. Practical experience using AI-enabled tools, including large language models, agents or scripted workflows, to improve analytical productivity, automation or decision support. Demonstrated ability to take incomplete and conflicting inputs from multiple sources and produce a single defensible view. Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar subject area and build sufficient domain understanding to analyse it effectively. Experience working across functions with different data sources, priorities and perspectives is strongly preferred. Exposure to executive, Board or committee reporting is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Analytical Reasoning: Break down complex questions, identify the relevant variables and determine the analysis required to support a decision. Data Interpretation and Judgement: Analyse information critically, identify patterns and anomalies, test assumptions and assess what can reasonably be concluded. Economic and Financial Acumen: Understand opportunity cost, incentives, cost behaviour, revenue, contribution and the financial implications of decisions. Modelling and Forecasting: Build and interpret scenarios, forecasts and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making. Digital and AI Fluency: Use analytical, automation and AI-enabled tools confidently to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs. Executive Communication: Distil complex analysis into clear findings, implications and recommendations appropriate to the audience and decision required. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Judgement: Recognise what matters, make sound calls with imperfect information and know when further analysis is warranted. Constructive Challenge: Question assumptions, identify weaknesses and raise material concerns directly and objectively. Ownership: Take responsibility for analytical quality, timeliness and usefulness from problem definition through to delivery. Collaboration: Work effectively across Finance, Data/IT, academic and professional functions while respecting ownership of underlying data and business processes. Delivery Discipline: Manage competing demands, coordinate contributors and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines. Continuous Improvement: Improve processes, tools and ways of working so that recurring work becomes more efficient, reliable and scalable. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - USA Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 5+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clover-health-data-analyst-clinical-data-effectiveness

items.description: About WOO X WOO X is a global centralised crypto trading platform offering spot and perpetual futures trading. With roots in quantitative trading, we focus on the details that matter to traders: liquidity, execution quality, and reliable tools. Transparency is part of the product. Our live Proof of Reserves & Liabilities dashboard gives users visibility into reported platform assets and user liabilities. Our team is fully remote. We’re looking for people who know their craft, are curious about the business, and want a hand in improving how the exchange works. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to maintain and develop WOO X’s data platform. You’ll build the pipelines and data models that make exchange data reliable and useful for analytics, reporting, and day-to-day business decisions. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a focus on platform engineering. You’ll work with engineering and business colleagues to understand how data is produced and used, address quality issues, and make the platform easier to maintain as requirements evolve. What you’ll do Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Python, SQL, Kafka, and Spark. Develop and operate Airflow workflows, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and recovery. Design and maintain data models and warehouse datasets for analytics and reporting. Improve data quality and freshness through validation, monitoring, and investigation of upstream and downstream issues. Optimise pipeline and query performance, and manage processing and storage costs. Work with data users to define datasets and metrics, and document data flows, transformations, and dependencies. What you’ll bring Data engineering experience within crypto or Web3, including responsibility for production pipelines or a data platform. Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building maintainable data processing workflows. Hands-on experience with Airflow, Kafka, and Spark. Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling. The ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and resolve underlying causes. The ability to work independently and communicate technical details and business requirements clearly in Mandarin. Nice to have Experience at a centralised crypto exchange, particularly with trading, order, or account data. BI experience, including supporting dashboards, defining metrics, or preparing datasets for business users. Strong English communication skills. Working with us This role is fully remote within APAC, with Mandarin as the team’s main working language. You’ll work on a data platform connected to the daily operations of a crypto exchange and help colleagues get dependable answers from its data. If you enjoy building data systems and understanding how people use them, we’d like to hear from you.

If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. items.description: Data and Analytics Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Role: As an Applied Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers. The work you’ll do: AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle. Hackathons & Prototyping: Rapidly build creative prototypes (LLM/Agent-based) to solve business-critical problems during customer hackathons. Agentic Process Transformation: Enable a fundamental shift for our customers from traditional automation to autonomous AI agents empowered by the Celonis PI Platform. Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Proof-of-Value (PoV) projects, including architecture, RAG, and guardrails, ensuring compliance with enterprise data and identity frameworks. Identify & Frame Value: Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives Realize Value: Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives Scale Value: Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use case The qualifications you need: Live for Customer Value: 4+ years of experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise. Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP/ Oracle), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Hands-on Experience with Process Mining tools and technologies is preferred. Hands-on SQL experience and Python . Experience in collaborating with IT teams. Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying business use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value. Domain and industry knowledge such as Supply chain, finance, CPG, BFSI, Manufacturing etc. would be a plus. Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible. Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Nice to have (big plus): Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails. Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages. Experience in deploying and monitoring models at scale across major cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP) What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

items.description: Product Headquarters: Czech Republic - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. As the leading collaborative work management platform, Wrike generates an enormous amount of rich, interconnected data, including work item content, relationships between entities, complex business processes, user interactions, and direct user input. The mission of the DS/ML department is to transform this data into intelligent, AI-powered capabilities that help users gain deeper insights, automate routine work, enhance productivity, and create a more seamless work experience. As a Data Scientist in the Work Intelligence Unit, you will play a key role in product development through the application of state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies with a particular focus on leveraging Large Language Models and other emerging technologies. You will work on both user-facing AI features and foundational intelligence platform that power intelligent experiences across the product. Your Impact: Creating new and improving existing AI solutions Involvement in the whole process of data-driven development from analyzing product requirements to launching the feature or system to production (with the help of MLOps specialists) and improving it based on results of monitoring and feedback Communicating with fellow data scientists, product owners, and developers Applying best software engineering practices to build a reliable codebase Performing code reviews Working in agile environment and presenting the results of your work on regular sprint reviews Your Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in AI, Data Science, and Machine learning Experience in LLMs, LLM-based APIs, prompting techniques, metric-driven development of prompt-based features, agentic systems, and other related topics Experience in building complex multipart and multistep LLM-based and ML systems Proficiency in Python (including pure Python, and not only jupyter notebooks) Experience in using reproducible research techniques Experience in developing AI solutions for production usage Full professional proficiency in English Standout Qualities: Experience in AI and ML solutions related to one of the areas: social networks, recommendation systems, ranking, entity matching, process mining, system personalization, risk estimation Confident statistical and machine learning skills Experience in creating core AI systems that are foundational to the product and are used in many parts of it Experience in classical software development and architecture Interpersonal skills: Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required with the ability to work within all levels of an organization. You are proactively pushing yourself to develop your skills and knowledge Decision making and argumentation skills Open to feedback and ready to react on it Ability to work autonomously on a project level Our Work Style: Code: Python, Jupyter, mypy, uv, black, flake8 Data: pandas, SQL, BigQuery GenAI & LLMs: Langchain, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Vertex AI, Braintrust LLM Platform: Versioned Prompt Registry(jinja2), Declarative LLM Feature Configs (multi-step workflows, model routing) ML: scikit-learn, lightgbm, pytorch Cloud: GCP, Dagster, MLFlow Coding Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Team Dynamics: As part of Wrike’s AI center of excellence — you will help scale AI feature development across teams by collaborating closely with product, engineering, design, research, and other departments across the organization. You will explore new AI-driven opportunities, validate hypotheses through experimentation, and drive innovations from research prototypes to production-ready capabilities that deliver tangible value to millions of users. Benefits & Perks: 5 Weeks of paid vacation Sick Leave Compensation 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 2 Volunteer Days Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day) Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka) Hybrid Working Model Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus What’s Next? Introduction Call with a Recruiter Technical interview Cultural interview Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova , Lead Recruiter. #LI-AV1 Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-senior-data-scientist
