items.title: Senior Data Analyst (MedTech)
items.summary: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.…
items.description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About the Role: YipitData's MedTech business is one of the fastest-growing verticals in the company. We provide institutional investors with differentiated data products covering the medical technology and devices landscape. The next phase of growth requires us to continue optimizing team performance while embracing new dataset evaluation and buildout – claims data, scripts data, pharma adjacencies, and other healthcare data domains – ultimately aimed at expanding our coverage universe and deepening our competitive moat. At the same time, we're navigating an intensifying competitive landscape that demands proactive data innovation. This role is the single biggest unlock for our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who can operate as a player-coach — staying close to the data while building and leading a team — to own both the ongoing quality and delivery of MedTech data products and the evaluation and development of new datasets that will fuel the sector’s growth. As Our Senior Data Analyst (MedTech), You Will: Team Leadership & Development Manage a team of 3–4 data analysts within your first 6–12 months, with responsibility for coaching and performance management Operate as a player-coach — stay hands-on with the data as needed while delegating operational execution across the team Set clear expectations and provide regular feedback , build a culture of ownership, quality, and accountability Coach team members on effective use of AI agents in their daily workflows, ensure your team is leveraging automation and tooling to maximize impact Develop team members' technical skills and domain knowledge , create growth paths that align individual development with business needs Existing Product Ownership & Quality Own overall data quality and accuracy across MedTech research products and analyses – including Research reports, company-level QA, coverage updates, and ad-hoc investigations Review and guide methodology decisions across the team, ensure rigor and consistency in how we process, validate, and deliver data Motivate and organize the team to continually improve data workflows, processing efficiency, and output quality Partner closely with the MedTech Research team as the data team counterpart, ensuring data products align with research priorities and client needs, and launching new coverage where applicable New Dataset Evaluation & Product Development Identify, scope, and lead evaluations of new data sources — including claims data, prescription data, and adjacent healthcare datasets — assessing commercial viability, data quality, coverage, and fit with our existing product suite Lead Data team in development of methodology and validation frameworks for new data domains, ensuring accuracy and reliability meet institutional investor standards Work with Sector Head to stay current on the healthcare data landscape — new data vendors, evolving regulatory environments, competitive product launches — to identify opportunities before they become obvious Strategic Contribution Translate sector priorities into team execution — ensure the team is focused on the highest-impact work at any given time Contribute to MedTech roadmap discussions and prioritization , bring a data-informed perspective on what to build next and where the biggest opportunities lie Identify opportunities to improve team workflows and processes , standardize best practices and drive efficiency gains Communicate priorities, timelines, and risks clearly to the Sector Head and cross-functional partners You Are Likely To Succeed If: 4-8+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or data product development , with a track record of building data assets in complex, data-intensive domains Strong technical skills mirroring a senior individual contributor (IC) profile: Experience working with large-scale, messy, real-world datasets — you know how to find signal in noise and build robust methodology around imperfect data Healthcare data experience — you've worked with healthcare, life sciences, pharma, biotech, or medical device data in a professional context. Deep MedTech expertise is preferred but not required; we value the ability to ramp quickly in a specialized domain. Strong problem-solving and analytical judgment — you can make high-quality decisions in ambiguous situations, prioritize effectively, and know when to go deep vs. when to move fast Clear, direct communication style — you can explain complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders and advocate for your team's priorities Preferred : Prior people management experience — you've managed a small team of analysts or data professionals, or you've operated as a team lead / senior IC with significant mentorship and project leadership responsibilities Experience in alternative data, financial data products, or investor-facing analytics — you understand what institutional investors need from data and how to build products that meet that bar Demonstrated ability to evaluate and scope new data sources end-to-end — from identifying a potential dataset through assessing quality, coverage, cost, and commercial viability Track record of building new data assets from zero to one — not just maintaining existing systems, but conceiving, validating, and shipping something new Experience with AI/ML tools and workflows — not necessarily building models, but leveraging AI for data processing, quality assurance, or analytical acceleration Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship. Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above! Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $175,000-$200,000 with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 10% . Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks. The compensation package also includes equity. This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security,…
items.description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Veeam is looking for a Senior Digital Experience Research Analyst to shape how millions of technology decision-makers experience us online. Sitting at the intersection of research, analytics, and digital strategy, you will own the full research lifecycle, from early discovery and user interviews through experimentation, measurement, and optimization, building the evidence base behind decisions across our global web presence. This is a role about bringing data to life: turning behavioral signals, test results, and user voices into narratives that move executives to act. You will work with significant autonomy, influence strategy at the executive level, and partner across marketing, corporate technology, and creative services to make sure every digital experience is built on insight rather than assumption. What You’ll Do Define and own the user research strategy and roadmap, scaling research frameworks, standards, and best practices across teams Lead qualitative and quantitative research initiatives, including user testing, interviews, surveys, competitive benchmarking, and expert reviews Analyze behavioral data and user feedback to uncover insights, friction points, and opportunities that shape product and design decisions Define and evolve the web measurement strategy, monitoring user behavior and performance and reporting through dashboards and executive presentations Own the experimentation program, including A/B and multivariate testing, partnering with design, product, and development teams to validate hypotheses and improve conversion and engagement Craft data stories that pair quantitative evidence with user voices, setting the bar for how insight is visualized and presented Build and maintain scalable research documentation and insight repositories so findings stay accessible and reusable across teams Technologies You’ll Work With Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics Adobe Target for personalization and testing UserTesting for qualitative research Microsoft Clarity for scroll maps, heatmaps, and session recordings Survey and interview tools What You’ll Bring Four or more years of experience, or equivalent skill, in user research, digital experience, conversion optimization, or a related field Proven experience defining and leading research strategy and programs Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics, and with Adobe Target for personalization and testing Demonstrated data storytelling ability, with examples of readouts that changed a decision Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and familiarity with accessibility standards Highly analytical and strategic, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across a matrixed organization Bonus Skills Experience with large-scale websites or digital platforms, particularly business-to-business Experience with qualitative research and behavior tools such as UserTesting, Microsoft Clarity, and Hotjar Experience applying AI tools across the research lifecycle, such as synthesizing interview transcripts, clustering open-ended feedback, spotting patterns in behavioral data, or accelerating analysis and reporting Experience building a research practice or insight repository from the ground up Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple competing priorities #LI-TS1 #remote What you'll get Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning Compensation Transparency Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range. In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off. U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE) Zone 1: San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Boroughs $154,560—$257,520 USD Zone 2: Washington, California (excluding San Francisco Bay Area) $141,680—$236,060 USD Zone 3: Texas, Illinois, North Carolina, Colorado, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Oregon, Nevada, Hawaii, New York (excluding NYC boroughs); Sales roles located in Georgia, Ohio, and Arizona $128,800—$214,600 USD Zone 4: All other US locations $112,056—$186,702 USD Veeam Software is an equal opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential. Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice , which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing. By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. Any misrepresentation, omission, or falsification may result in disqualification from consideration or, if discovered after employment begins, termination of employment.

items.description: Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands . We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks. Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results. Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience. We believe in: The direct measurability of digital media. Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.) The advantages of technology. We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel. Job Category We are seeking an autonomous, driven, and data-fluent Account Manager to join our performance marketing team, specializing in the health and Medicare insurance category. In this role, you will own client relationships with health/Medicare carriers, brokers, agencies, and aggregators. You will act as a proactive strategic partner—optimizing revenue, managing media performance, and driving client portfolio growth. Because this is a fully remote position, we are looking for a natural self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment, takes complete ownership of their accounts, and proactively uncovers new revenue opportunities. Responsibilities Client Portfolio Management & Strategy: Own end-to-end relationships with a portfolio of health and Medicare insurance clients, serving as their primary strategic advisor. Proactive Revenue Growth: Proactively identify opportunities to scale client accounts, optimize performance, and expand the client profile to drive category revenue. Performance Optimization: Monitor and analyze key performance indicators—including revenue, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and media buying metrics—to hit or exceed client targets and KPIs. Performance Marketing Execution: Manage lead generation, calls, and clicks performance campaigns specifically tailored to the insurance sector. Data Analysis & Reporting: Leverage advanced tools to evaluate campaign performance, build insightful reports, and communicate actionable insights clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders. items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Account Executive for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. Comp: €110K-€135K base, €220K-€270K OTE + equity Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email). Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed. Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta .ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

items.description: At Roofr , we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products. We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact. This position is for an existing vacancy. ***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.*** Roofr is growing our Onboarding team, and we're looking for a Spanish-speaking Onboarding Manager (contract) to own the most important window in a customer's journey: the moment they sign to the moment they're live, confident, and getting real value from Roofr. We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products. Many of them run established roofing businesses but are new to technology, which means the way you show up matters as much as what you know. This role is built for someone who thrives in high-volume environments, believes great onboarding creates the conditions for everything that comes after, and finds real satisfaction in watching a customer go from uncertain to capable. Your goal is simple: help customers feel the difference Roofr makes in their business as quickly as possible, and make sure getting there doesn't feel overwhelming. We pay attention to two things to know we're on track: how much of what a customer set out to use in Roofr they're actually working with day-to-day, and whether they'd say the onboarding experience genuinely helped them. Those signals tell us where customers are thriving and where we can do better. They're our compass. What You’ll Do: Own the full onboarding journey for net-new Roofr customers, from supporting them through Account Setup and training through to a clean handoff to their Customer Success Manager. Manage multiple concurrent onboardings in a high-volume environment, balancing dedicated 1:1 sessions with scalable, group-based training. Guide customers through Roofr in a way that’s practical, confidence-building, and tailored to their unique business workflows, goals, and level of technical experience. Drive customers to a clear graduation milestone: they're live, self-sufficient, and ready for handoff to their Customer Success Manager.. Work closely with the Account Setup Team as an onboarding consultant, ensuring Roofr is configured to reflect each customer's real needs and lay the foundation for strong adoption. Deliver engaging live training sessions and group webinars that drive real adoption, not just familiarity. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Retention, Product, and the Customer Success team to surface friction, close gaps, and ensure every handoff is clean. Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of Roofr's onboarding playbook, building something that scales, not just something that works today. Act as a trusted guide during a high-stakes window, helping customers prioritize, build good habits, and set themselves up for long-term success in Roofr. What You'll Bring to the Role: Fluent in Spanish (written and spoken) 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or enablement within an SMB, B2B, or SaaS environment Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment Strong communication and presentation skills across live calls, video meetings, email, and webinars Ability to build rapport quickly and adapt your approach based on customer goals, maturity, and engagement level Proven ability to manage customer needs while making thoughtful, outcome-driven recommendations Comfort demonstrating product value and guiding customers toward broader adoption and better business outcomes High ownership mentality with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and follow through consistently Exceptional organization, time management, and attention to detail to deliver a reliable, high-quality onboarding experience Who You Are: A true customer advocate Highly organized and results-oriented Detail-obsessed (in the best way) You know how to adapt your approach depending on who’s in front of you. You are always looking for ways to improve and scale what works Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools quickly Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact. What we offer (US + Canada) When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: ️ Vacation/Paid Time Off: 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2! 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!) Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years Flexible time off 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada RRSP/401k match Generous Parental Leave policy Perks: We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career Home office setup stipend Internet and phone allowance Remote first culture Weekly Friday paydays! AI Notice At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you. Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users ). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too. And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️ ⚠️ Important Notice We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers . If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com . Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance! Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

We’re looking for experienced ML/AI researchers with a strong publication track record at top-tie
items.description: Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection. We’re looking for experienced ML/AI researchers with a strong publication track record at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) to support an advanced AI research evaluation project. You'll critically assess scientific papers and research outputs generated by autonomous AI research agents, evaluating their technical correctness, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality against the standards of leading ML/AI conferences. This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours. Tasks What you'll be doing What you'll be doing Critically evaluate AI-generated ML/AI research papers , assessing their scientific contributions, technical correctness, methodology, experimental design, and conclusions Assess scientific novelty and significance , determining whether proposed approaches represent meaningful advancements over existing state-of-the-art research Evaluate experimental rigor and validity , including baseline comparisons, benchmark selection, evaluation metrics, statistical evidence, and ablation studies Identify methodological flaws, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, or misleading results that undermine the scientific validity of proposed contributions Assess reproducibility and technical soundness , including whether reported findings are sufficiently supported by experimental evidence and, where available, accompanying code and implementation details Review and verify relevant academic literature , identifying overlooked prior work, inaccurate citations, and unsupported novelty claims Evaluate whether AI-generated research meets the scientific standards of top-tier ML/AI conferences , such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR Provide structured, evidence-based assessments of research quality, including strengths, weaknesses, critical technical concerns, and overall scientific merit Apply detailed evaluation rubrics consistently , providing clear, well-reasoned justifications for your assessments The project focuses on evaluating advanced AI-generated scientific research, with an emphasis on technical validity, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality. Your role is to provide expert human judgment on whether the resulting research is scientifically valid, genuinely novel, and of a quality comparable to work accepted at leading ML/AI conferences. Requirements You're a strong candidate if you: Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated research expertise Have published at least 3 peer-reviewed research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR (hard requirement) , ideally including first-author or significant research contributions Have substantial hands-on ML/AI research experience , including developing novel methods, designing experiments, analyzing results, and publishing original scientific work Have a strong understanding of scientific methodology and experimental rigor , including appropriate baselines, statistical validity, benchmark design, ablation studies, and reproducibility Can independently assess the novelty, significance, and technical soundness of advanced ML/AI research , identifying both meaningful scientific contributions and fundamental methodological weaknesses Have experience reviewing research papers for top-tier ML/AI conferences or journals , ideally NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR — strongly preferred Are highly familiar with state-of-the-art ML/AI research and can critically assess new methods against existing literature and established benchmarks Are comfortable verifying scientific claims , including reviewing technical arguments, experimental evidence, citations, and, where relevant, code implementations Have strong analytical and scientific writing skills and can articulate nuanced technical judgments through concise, evidence-based feedback Can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines and scoring rubrics while exercising independent expert judgment Have exceptional attention to detail , particularly when identifying subtle methodological flaws, unsupported conclusions, or discrepancies between claims and evidence Benefits Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere Part-time contractor role with flexible hours Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge autonomous AI systems capable of conducting end-to-end scientific research Apply your research expertise to help assess and advance the scientific capabilities of frontier AI agents Send us your CV along with a brief note about your research background, areas of expertise, and publication record. Please include links to at least 3 peer-reviewed publications at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR , as well as any relevant academic peer-review experience. If applicable, we'd also love to know which ML/AI research areas you're most familiar with and whether you've served as a reviewer, area chair, or in a similar capacity at major research conferences. We look forward to hearing from you! Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

items.description: The Climate Bonds Initiative is an international NGO working to mobilise global capital for climate action. Our mission is to develop trusted standards, tools, and market intelligence that accelerate the transition to a climate-resilient and low-carbon economy. The Resilience Product and Adoption Lead will lead on external adoption of the Climate Bonds Resilience Taxonomy (CBRT) and the resilience component of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy , as well as any new resilience products, to guide investment in climate Adaptation and Resilience (A&R). The overarching goal will be to ensure the uptake of these tools by ensuring they are fit-for-purpose, user-friendly and interoperable with the emerging approaches and decisions of a range of target stakeholders. The post will also support ad hoc technical advisory and consultancy services relating to resilience, especially in engaging financial institutions. Clarify for Climate Bonds commercial teams how to standardise a product range - leveraging the resilience taxonomy – to accelerate uptake by financial institutions. Work with other engagement teams across Climate Bonds, including but not limited to the regional teams and investor teams, seeking strategic entry and engagement with large-scale investors. Factor the thinking of regional and policy teams into evolving use cases for the CBRT (and / or resilience elements of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy). Support a ‘Certification Task Force’ or equivalent, that ensures robust and timely response to inbound queries around application of the resilience taxonomy. Promote the full range of Climate Bonds resilience products (particularly the CBRT and the resilience elements of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy) Work with the relevant Climate Bonds Teams on a long-term strategy for visibility around the resilience taxonomy. Participate in external advisory groups and events to promote the CBRT and other taxonomy products related to resilience. Ensure that CBRT development is aligned with due consideration to ‘product-market’ placem ent Cultivate relationships with financial institutions, investors, governments, and multilateral agencies who wish to adopt or incorporate the CBRT and the resilience component of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy in their operations and guidance. Based on this engagement, outline and strengthen specific use cases for the CBRT, clarifying which to invest in (and hence which not to prioritise). Do this by working with other engagement teams across Climate Bonds, including but not limited to the regional teams and investor teams. Institutionalise strong feedback loops within Climate Bonds to ensure that lessons from ‘external engagement’ with the CBRT are fed back into plans for further development of either the taxonomy or specific use cases (includes liaison with the Climate Bonds Data Team to ensure that market trends and the needs of the data customers are factored in). Direct and manage the evolution of the CBRT (as a tool / platform) to better serve user needs, as well as adapt to a world where AI is reshaping work patterns globally. Contribute to a full suite of resilience produc ts Work with the Head of Resilience to support the development of new resilience products, should a clear need be identified via market feedback and the internal resilience strategy. Support resilience-related advisory work Work with capacity building, technical assistance and regional teams both to scope and deliver external engagement work, whether advisory, capacity building or other. Support fundraising for the CBRT and related strategic partnerships Work with the Head of Resilience and fundraising teams to raise money for the further development of Work with the Head of Resilience to develop and deepen strategic partnerships that drive widespread adoption of the resilience taxonomy. Experience working in finance or close to financial institutions Experience in external engagement to ensure uptake of knowledge products or services Relationship building and stakeholder management, preferably in sustainable finance Excellent engagement and relationship management skills, including a track record of collaborating with a cross section of stakeholder groups Decent grasp of sustainable finance concepts Strong public speaking and presentation skills Proven experience of delivering projects independently Ability to manage complex projects with multiple partners Fluency in verbal and written English Desirable: Advanced degree in any related subject Experience in taxonomy or standards development Experience in A&R Experience working in emerging markets Experience brokering between teams ‘developing a product’ and teams ‘using or selling a product’. items.description: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C Duration: 13 months, anticipated from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027 Estimated level of effort: Equivalent to three (3) days per week Location and availability: This is a remote consultancy open to applicants globally, with applications particularly encouraged from consultants based in Asia and Africa. The Consultant must be able to coordinate across time zones and participate in agreed meetings with the Platform’s international membership. About the Global Platform: The Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C is a consortium of civil society organisations, champions, survivors, and grassroots representatives working together to accelerate the abandonment and prevention of female genital mutilation/cutting (FGM/C). Established following consultations initiated at the 2019 Women Deliver conference in Vancouver, the Global Platform brings together members across regions to exchange knowledge, strengthen collaboration, and advance collective advocacy. Its Global Call to Action to End FGM/C, launched in November 2019, calls for urgent, coordinated action to end FGM/C. The Global Platform works across intersecting movements, including those addressing sexual and gender-based violence, sexual and reproductive health and rights, and child, early, and forced marriage. Purpose of the Consultancy: The Global Platform seeks a consultant to provide coordination, governance, membership, and communications support. The assignment will help translate members’ collective commitments into an achievable programme of joint action and strengthen the Platform’s longer-term sustainability. The consultancy will focus on three priorities, in the following order: Strengthening governance and membership arrangements. Establishing consistent coordination and communications. Supporting resource mobilisation and longer-term sustainability. Advocacy activities, events, and other requests will be prioritised within the agreed workplan, level of effort, and available budget. Scope of Work and Expected Deliverables: 1. Inception and work planning In consultation with the Core Group and Equality Now , the Consultant will: Review existing governance documents, membership arrangements, communications channels, and relevant commitments. Prepare an inception workplan within the first month, setting out deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and a realistic allocation of the available consultancy time. Identify decisions, member contributions, and resources needed to complete the assignment. 2. Governance and membership The Consultant will: Facilitate consultation on, and prepare a final draft of, the Platform’s membership terms of reference, including the proposed two-tier membership model, for Core Group approval. Develop practical guidance on membership, decision-making, and the respective responsibilities of members and the Core Group. Establish an organised membership database using an agreed system, with appropriate access and information-handling arrangements. Develop a membership outreach and onboarding approach, prioritising grassroots and survivor-led organisations and organisations based in the Global Majority. Produce an accessible overview of the Platform, its purpose, and opportunities for participation. 3. Coordination and member engagement The Consultant will: Coordinate monthly Core Group meetings, including scheduling, preparation, and follow-up. Circulate agendas and relevant materials at least one (1) week before each meeting, subject to timely input from members. Circulate meeting records and an updated action tracker within five (5) working days after each meeting. Maintain a central record of agreed decisions, actions, responsibilities, and deadlines. Provide a central contact point for Platform enquiries and coordinate responses with the appropriate members. Facilitate member contributions and flag outstanding decisions or dependencies that may affect delivery. 4. Communications and shared resources The Consultant will: Develop and implement a proportionate communications schedule covering the internal listserv, public mailing list, and social media channels. Coordinate member contributions and prepare content for approval through agreed processes. Coordinate website content updates and provide agreed content and member input to the external website redesign consultant. Support the development of common messages and positioning for Core Group approval. Organise key documents and resources so that members can access and use them. 5. Strategic planning and sustainability The Consultant will: Facilitate the development of a three-year strategic workplan, including objectives, priority actions, indicative responsibilities, and resource requirements, for Core Group approval. Develop a practical tracker for commitments under the Movement-led Collective Vision on Ending FGM/C, drawing on updates provided by participating members. Map potential funding and partnership opportunities and recommend a prioritised approach to follow-up. Prepare a concise impact summary and a core set of materials to support partnership development and fundraising. Develop recommendations for sustaining the Platform’s coordination function beyond the consultancy period. The Consultant will support resource mobilisation but will not be responsible for guaranteeing funding or the performance of individual member organisations. 6. Joint advocacy and events Within the agreed workplan and available resources, the Consultant will: Provide secretariat support for the Platform’s engagement with the FGM/C Donor Working Group. Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of three shared advocacy materials during the consultancy period. items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY Storyblok is hiring a Salesforce Lead to own Salesforce architecture, execution, governance, data quality, integrations, and release discipline across our GTM workflows. This techno-functional owner moves from business process to system design, build coordination, release control, data quality, reporting impact, and user adoption, owning Sales Cloud and core CRM objects, Pardot / Account Engagement, DealHub CPQ integration, lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash workflows, routing, campaign and lifecycle data, permissions, integrations, and documentation. The role also leads future platform evaluation for Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs, and, if a platform is selected, leads implementation planning and execution with RevOps, Marketing Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, vendors, and external partners. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Salesforce architecture and GTM systems governance Own Salesforce platform architecture across GTM workflows, objects, fields, permissions, automations, integrations, and release control. Translate RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Data requirements into clean system design and controlled execution. Maintain governance for new fields, objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reporting dependencies, and documentation. Sales Cloud and core CRM ownership Own system design for leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities, campaigns, lifecycle stages, routing, renewals, expansions, and customer handoffs. Support lead-to-cash workflows with clear ownership, required fields, source logic, stage rules, assignment logic, and adoption checks. Monitor CRM completeness, data freshness, duplicates, routing failures, and workflow friction that creates manual workarounds. Pardot, Account Engagement, and marketing workflow support Partner with Marketing Operations on Pardot or Account Engagement, campaign data, lifecycle stages, scoring inputs, consent, routing, attribution support, and funnel reporting. Maintain the Salesforce-side architecture for marketing-to-sales handoffs, campaign member data, source fields, conversion logic, and reporting quality. Keep current marketing workflows stable while future marketing cloud and CDP options are evaluated. Future Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle, and CDP evaluation Lead the requirements, scorecard, architecture review, vendor comparison, data governance review, and implementation readiness plan for future customer data and marketing cloud decisions. Evaluate Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs against GTM use cases, data model, activation, consent, reporting, integration, cost, and operating complexity. If a platform is selected, lead implementation planning and execution with clear phases, owners, risks, testing, migration, enablement, and adoption metrics. DealHub CPQ integration, data quality, releases, and adoption Own Salesforce-side integration quality for DealHub CPQ, including quote data, approval sync, product lines, opportunity fields, order handoffs, and reporting impact. Run release management with intake, solution design, testing, regression checks, deployment, communication, documentation, and adoption tracking. Partner with Data on source-to-report logic so Salesforce, warehouse, Finance, and leadership reporting stay aligned. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including hands-on administration and solution / architecture ownership in a GTM or Revenue Operations context. Salesforce certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder; Sales Cloud Consultant or Application Architect a plus). Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, core CRM objects, declarative automation (Flow), permissions, and release / change management across environments. Experience with Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and marketing-to-sales workflows, and with CPQ tools (DealHub or comparable) across lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash. Experience integrating Salesforce with downstream systems (data warehouse, Finance, marketing, order management) and supporting reporting and data quality. Familiarity with CDP / marketing cloud platform evaluation (e.g., Salesforce Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle Responsys) is a plus. Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES Systems thinking: translates cross-functional business requirements into clean, scalable system design and governance. Technical CRM depth: strong command of Salesforce architecture, data model, automation, permissions, and integrations. Release and change discipline: structured intake, testing, regression, deployment, documentation, and adoption tracking. Data quality and governance orientation: drives completeness, freshness, deduplication, and field control. Stakeholder management: partners effectively across RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, CS, Finance, Data, Legal, and vendors. Vendor and platform evaluation: builds requirements, scorecards, and implementation readiness plans for major platform decisions. Clear communication: explains what is being built, the decision needed, and the business outcome to technical and non-technical audiences. Bias for reliability: reduces defects, manual workarounds, and ambiguity through documentation and controlled execution. U.S. Base Salary Range: $102,900 - $140,000 At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure. MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-salesforce-lead-usa

items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, United States; San Francisco, California, United States About Checkr Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic. We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company . About the Role Truework, recently acquired by Checkr, provides access to crucial employment, income information and asset information needed for mortgage loans, apartment rentals, background checks, and more. We are disrupting a $5B+ industry, dominated by legacy incumbents and outdated processes, with a better product and intense customer focus. Within Checkr, Truework operates independently, allowing rapid iteration while also being able to leverage the strengths and assets from our core business. Think of it like joining a startup within a startup! As a Strategic Account Executive on the Truework team, you’ll help scale our impact across large national and regional lenders, with a primary focus on acquiring new clients to Truework Verification services. As automated verification services become a more common practice for lenders in how they run their operation, you’ll lead the charge in building and executing a more repeatable playbook to drive new customers who will grow with us for years to come. By deeply understanding their unique company challenges and goals, you will pair them with solutions that will help them reach their business objectives and innovate within their organizations. This role is ideal for a proven sales professional who: has experience selling transformational solutions to customers, where you can quickly identify and pattern map where and how the Truework solution can drive impact in a customer’s operation has experience identifying and building relationships with decision makers, business and technology influencers and users, closing 6- and 7-figure pursuits who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment— ready to help close the gap between the legacy solutions and processes lending teams are leaning on and their plans and intentions to deliver competitive and streamlined processes for consumers You will be an important part of an elite, professional, and rapidly growing cross-functional team that succeeds through collaboration, grit, and learning. What you’ll do Deliver Sales Excellence: Consistently achieve pipeline and revenue targets by applying modern sales techniques and processes to efficiently manage top of funnel engagement tactics and deal strategy and close processes Think outside-the-box to cultivate awareness of the Truework vision. Plan and execute targeted campaigns for your territory working with the marketing and partner teams to scale your coverage and build pipeline Partner with and guide the efforts of our internal team to support your accounts in pre-sales activities and in the deployment to execute on agreed upon account goals, strategies and tactics for growth Leverage analytics, case studies, past performance, and market intelligence to create a territory plan and craft your own target account strategies. Manage Account Relationships: Have an understanding of the lender’s operation and an ability to identify the varying use cases where verification services can drive impact Exhibit deep and up-to-date knowledge of our product portfolio in order to communicate the benefits of new features and enhancements Show proficiency in navigating buy team personas, with intentional activities for executive bridging and champion building Exhibit Industry- & Customer-specific Business Acumen: Actively understand each customer’s strategic growth plans, technology footprint, and corresponding technology strategy, internal challenges, and competitive landscape. Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to stay updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect. Be equipped to identify and discover centers of value for lenders, and conduct analysis to quantify ROI and impact of our solution on their operation Be a good teammate Represent both market trends and client needs to the Executive and the Product teams to ensure we are both serving current needs well and evolving our products and portfolio to identify future client needs Show unparalleled grit - constantly experiment, be willing to pivot, and have resiliency regardless of the obstacles faced What you bring 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience, selling transformative technology solutions Experience closing new business accounts and building pipeline using modern marketing tactics Experience selling to EVPs, CXOs and end-users (in the same sales cycle) in both individual and team sales environments Ability to navigate large organizations’ political landscape to maintain and expand relationships at all levels General knowledge in common sales practices like MEDDPICC, Command of the Message (Force Management), Challenger, Power Selling, or others Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to simplify complex topics in a friendly and approachable manner, present executive-level business cases Ability to juggle and complete multiple priorities and projects (internally and externally) in a fast-paced environment You are smart, self-motivated, organized, disciplined, inquisitive, detail-oriented, and process-oriented; you have an ownership mentality within all aspects of your work You have a growth mindset that is always learning, growing, and actively seeking feedback You have a team-first mentality—you show up for your team and expect the same in return. You enjoy planning, adjusting, executing, winning, and celebrating as a team. An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes. Pay Transparency Disclosure We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website . To live by that value, we’ve made the decision to disclose salary ranges in all of our job postings. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website . Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages.
