items.description: Job Summary: The Senior Medical Director, Medical Science, is an experienced physician leader who provides strategic medical, scientific, and operational leadership across clinical development programs while serving as a trusted advisor to sponsors, investigators, and cross-functional teams. This role combines medical monitoring expertise with sponsor-facing leadership, business development support, and study oversight responsibilities, including the potential to serve as a global project lead. The Senior Medical Director is expected to represent the organization as the medical and scientific authority in client interactions, proposal development, bid defense meetings, scientific presentations, and industry conferences. Through proactive client engagement, expert clinical judgment, and collaborative leadership, this individual drives high-quality study execution, contributes to protocol and study design, supports safety oversight and data interpretation, mentors Medical Directors and other colleagues, and identifies opportunities for innovation and process improvement. The Senior Medical Director exemplifies accountability, integrity, and a passion for clinical research and patient care while consistently delivering exceptional value to clients, patients, and the organization. Main Responsibilities: Serve as a senior medical and scientific leader in sponsor interactions, building trusted partnerships through proactive consultation, strategic insight, and exceptional service delivery. Represent the organization as the physician and subject matter expert during client meetings, scientific presentations, conferences, proposal discussions, and bid defense activities. Provide medical and scientific expertise during client feasibility assessments, including evaluation of study design, patient populations, enrollment strategies, and site selection. Serve as Medical Monitor for assigned studies, acting as the primary medical contact for sponsors, investigators, and study teams, providing medical oversight of patient safety, ensuring scientific rigor and operational excellence throughout study execution. Review and interpret laboratory data, adverse events, medical coding dictionaries, and study data outputs, including tables, listings, and figures. Review and provide expert input into the Medical Monitoring Plan, study protocols, statistical analysis plans, case report forms, training materials, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, and other key study documents. Conduct independent medical analyses of emerging study data and effectively communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to sponsors and internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Safety/Pharmacovigilance teams to review safety documentation and support safety signal evaluation and risk management activities. Contribute medical expertise to safety review meetings, data monitoring activities, and governance committees as required. Lead complex global clinical programs and provide oversight and guidance to regional medical leaders and project teams, as appropriate. Participate in investigator meetings and scientific advisory discussions as the medical representative for assigned programs. Mentor, coach, and develop Medical Directors, Associate Medical Directors, and other colleagues across the organization. Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, quality, and client experience across Medical Sciences and the broader organization, contributing to organizational initiatives that advance scientific excellence, operational effectiveness, and innovation. Education and Experience: Minimum Education & Experience: MD, DO, MBBS or equivalent education with completion of residency in a medical or pediatric sub-specialty, including completion of a fellowship in hematology and/or oncology At least 10 years combined experience in academic and/or industry clinical research in drug development. Experience as a Medical Monitor on clinical oncology and/or rare clinical trials is required Clinical practice experience of a minimum of 3-5 years preferred Board certification in hematology and/or oncology preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies: Lead with integrity, professionalism, and transparency in all interactions. Anticipate client needs and provide innovative solutions that consistently meet or exceed expectations. Lead medical strategy and scientific discussions in both prepared and extemporaneous settings. Demonstrate accountability and ownership for outcomes, proactively identifying root causes of issues and implementing sustainable solutions. Model company values and foster a culture focused on patient care, scientific excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Effective level of communication (both written and verbal) skills and effective level of salesmanship and presentation skills. Proficiency and sensitivity to work in a global company with reports from varied cultures and backgrounds #LI-KH1 #LI-Remote Precision is required by law in some states or cities to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This role combines medical monitoring expertise with sponsor-facing leadership, business development support, and study oversight responsibilities, including the potential to serve as a global project lead. The Senior Medical Director is expected to represent the organization as the medical and scientific authority in client interactions, proposal development, bid defense meetings, scientific presentations, and industry conferences. Through proactive client engagement, expert clinical judgment, and collaborative leadership, this individual drives high-quality study execution, contributes to protocol and study design, supports safety oversight and data interpretation, mentors Medical Directors and other colleagues, and identifies opportunities for innovation and process improvement. The Senior Medical Director exemplifies accountability, integrity, and a passion for clinical research and patient care while consistently delivering exceptional value to clients, patients, and the organization. Main Responsibilities: Serve as a senior medical and scientific leader in sponsor interactions, building trusted partnerships through proactive consultation, strategic insight, and exceptional service delivery. Represent the organization as the physician and subject matter expert during client meetings, scientific presentations, conferences, proposal discussions, and bid defense activities. Provide medical and scientific expertise during client feasibility assessments, including evaluation of study design, patient populations, enrollment strategies, and site selection. Serve as Medical Monitor for assigned studies, acting as the primary medical contact for sponsors, investigators, and study teams, providing medical oversight of patient safety, ensuring scientific rigor and operational excellence throughout study execution. Review and interpret laboratory data, adverse events, medical coding dictionaries, and study data outputs, including tables, listings, and figures. Review and provide expert input into the Medical Monitoring Plan, study protocols, statistical analysis plans, case report forms, training materials, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, and other key study documents. Conduct independent medical analyses of emerging study data and effectively communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to sponsors and internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Safety/Pharmacovigilance teams to review safety documentation and support safety signal evaluation and risk management activities. Contribute medical expertise to safety review meetings, data monitoring activities, and governance committees as required. Lead complex global clinical programs and provide oversight and guidance to regional medical leaders and project teams, as appropriate. Participate in investigator meetings and scientific advisory discussions as the medical representative for assigned programs. Mentor, coach, and develop Medical Directors, Associate Medical Directors, and other colleagues across the organization. Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, quality, and client experience across Medical Sciences and the broader organization, contributing to organizational initiatives that advance scientific excellence, operational effectiveness, and innovation. Education and Experience: Minimum Education & Experience: MD, DO, MBBS or equivalent education with completion of residency in a medical or pediatric sub-specialty, including completion of a fellowship in hematology and/or oncology At least 10 years combined experience in academic and/or industry clinical research in drug development. Experience as a Medical Monitor on clinical oncology and/or rare clinical trials is required Clinical practice experience of a minimum of 3-5 years preferred Board certification in hematology and/or oncology preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies: Lead with integrity, professionalism, and transparency in all interactions. Anticipate client needs and provide innovative solutions that consistently meet or exceed expectations. Lead medical strategy and scientific discussions in both prepared and extemporaneous settings. Demonstrate accountability and ownership for outcomes, proactively identifying root causes of issues and implementing sustainable solutions. Model company values and foster a culture focused on patient care, scientific excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Effective level of communication (both written and verbal) skills and effective level of salesmanship and presentation skills. Proficiency and sensitivity to work in a global company with reports from varied cultures and backgrounds #LI-KH1 #LI-Remote Precision is required by law in some states or cities to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Precision, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits. Reasonable estimate of the current range $254,900—$382,300 USD Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice. Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com. Recruitment Fraud Warning: Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. items.description: Job Overview Wargaming is looking for a Senior UI Designer to join the World of Tanks Modern Armor team. In this role, you’ll design and evolve complex UI systems that make gameplay intuitive, engaging, and accessible. Our ideal candidate has experience working on PC or console games and is eager to bring new ideas and improvements to the project, helping us take the player experience to the next level. Our primary hiring location is Belgrade , but we’re also open to candidates based in Nicosia or Vilnius . Reports to Lead Game Designer What will you do? Designs and maintains complex UI systems that support multiple gameplay mechanics, features, or interconnected product areas Defines interaction patterns, scalable information architecture, and reusable design solutions within assigned scope Creates and maintains comprehensive implementation documentation, UI guidelines, component usage rules, and design standards Ensures UI solutions support gameplay clarity, accessibility, engagement, retention, and overall player experience goals Identifies usability risks, implementation constraints, and design inconsistencies and drives improvements across systems Mentors less experienced UI designers and supports design quality through reviews, feedback, and knowledge sharing Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to align UI solutions with product, technical, and artistic objectives What are we looking for? 5+ years of experience designing complex, intuitive user interfaces for games Ability to design scalable UI systems and establish reusable patterns and standards Experience using analytics, user research, and feedback to drive design decisions Ability to lead discussions, resolve design challenges, and influence cross-functional decisions Basic understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and player behavior Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English knowledge What additional skills will help you stand out? Experience working with AI tools Experience working with Scaleform/Flash Work mode This position is open in our Belgrade, Vilnius and Nicosia offices Onsite or hybrid (2-3 days per week in the office) This role is eligible for relocation & immigration support The salary range for this role in Vilnius is EUR 4100 monthly gross. Benefits Benefits and perks are tailored to the local market and culture. Our benefits in Vilnius include: Additional paid time off Sick Leave Compensation Pregnancy and Childbirth Leave Benefit Career development and education opportunities within the company Meal Allowance Premium Private Health Care Mental well-being program (iFeel) Perks discounts platform (over 450 exclusive discounts) Personal Gaming Account Coffee, fruits, and snacks in the office Company events Seniority Awards Referral program - You can recommend the best talents to the company and receive a reward Please submit your CV in English to ensure smooth processing and review. About Wargaming Wargaming is an award-winning online game developer and publisher headquartered in Nicosia, Cyprus. Operating since 1998, Wargaming has become one of the leaders in the gaming industry with 15 offices worldwide, including studios in Chicago, Prague, Shanghai, Tokyo, and Vilnius. Our diverse and multicultural team works together to deliver a top-class experience to millions of players who enjoy Wargaming’s titles across all major gaming platforms. Our flagship products include free-to-play hits World of Tanks, World of Warships and World of Tanks Blitz. Please see Wargaming Candidate Privacy Policy for details on how Wargaming uses your personal data.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.title: Lead Creative
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.
